titleZh: 帶有深厚的個人情感意義

brief.meaningEn: Personal or emotional significance that makes something matter to someone.
brief.meaningZh: 令某物對當事人重要的個人情感意義。
brief.grammar: have/carry emotional weight for someone; explain whose attachment and what connection are involved.
brief.register: Natural figurative collocation using weight for significance; the object’s market price is a separate matter.
brief.boundaryZh: 情感分量不等於重量、價格或人人同樣重視；需要個人聯繫的線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 別人沒有相同回憶，不代表當事人的珍惜是假的；也不需把物件說成最昂貴。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體回憶支持情感意義，分開私人依戀及客觀價格。

listening.en: The chipped bowl carried emotional weight for Ravi because his father had used it every morning; its value to him was not explained by the price of a replacement.
listening.zh: 有缺口的碗對拉維帶情感分量，因父親每天早上都用它；對他的價值，不能用替代品價格解釋。
listening.promptZh: 碗的情感分量來自甚麼？

options.en: Its connection with his father’s daily routine.
options.zh: 它與父親日常的聯繫。

options.en: A confirmed high resale price for the bowl.
options.zh: 已確認的碗轉售高價。

options.en: Its physical weight compared with a replacement.
options.zh: 它與替代品相比的實際重量。

options.en: Its usefulness in Ravi’s present morning routine.
options.zh: 它對拉維目前早晨日常的實用價值。

listening.explanationZh: 父親每日使用的回憶是已給聯繫，不是轉售價、碗的重量或拉維目前使用的便利。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼拉維這麼重視那隻有缺口的碗？
reply.promptEn: Why does Ravi care so much about the chipped bowl?

options.en: It reminds him of his father using it each morning.
options.zh: 它讓他想起父親每天早上用碗。

options.en: It has emotional weight because it is linked to his father’s daily life.
options.zh: 它與父親日常相連，所以帶情感分量。

options.en: His attachment comes from that familiar routine rather than a replacement price.
options.zh: 他的依戀來自熟悉日常，而非替代品價格。

options.en: The bowl is part of his memory of his father.
options.zh: 碗是他對父親回憶的一部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給具體個人聯繫，不推市場價。

scene.promptZh: 一封普通明信片讓你想起朋友在你初到外地時的支持，你一直保存它，並不是因收藏價。哪句貼切？

options.en: The postcard has emotional weight because of the support it recalls.
options.zh: 明信片因喚起支持回憶而帶情感分量。

options.en: Its importance is based on a verified collector’s price rather than your memory.
options.zh: 重要性基於已核實收藏價，而非你的回憶。

options.en: You keep it for its practical travel information rather than the friendship it recalls.
options.zh: 你為實用旅遊資訊而留它，而非它喚起的友誼。

scene.explanationZh: 題目給朋友支持及保存，符合個人意義。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 emotional weight 得出？

options.en: Something carries personal feeling or significance in the context.
options.zh: 某物在情境中帶個人感受或意義。

options.en: Its market price must exceed that of every replacement.
options.zh: 它的市價必定高於每件替代品。

options.en: The person’s connection may help explain why it matters.
options.zh: 當事人的聯繫可幫解釋為甚麼重要。

contrast.explanationZh: 情感意義不能直接算成市價高低。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說可買便宜新碗，就認為拉維不應珍惜舊碗；你想保留兩種價值的區別。哪句較準確？

options.en: A replacement can serve the same practical purpose without carrying his memories.
options.zh: 替代品可有相同實用功能，卻未必承載他的回憶。

options.en: An identical-looking replacement should carry the same personal meaning for him.
options.zh: 外觀相同的替代品，應對他有相同個人意義。

options.en: Perhaps the old bowl matters because it is more convenient to use than a new one.
options.zh: 也許舊碗重要，是因為它比新碗更方便使用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已知的意義來自父親的日常回憶；相同外觀或使用便利未必能取代這種聯繫。

speaking.en: The object has emotional weight for me, even though a replacement would serve the same practical purpose.
speaking.zh: 物件對我有情感分量，儘管替代品也有相同實用功能。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清情感及功能。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們整理畢業演出資料，某段錄音聲音不清，但留有團隊第一次一起試唱及笑着重來的片段。你想保留它並註明是早期練習，不冒充最佳正式演出。用一至兩句英文向同伴解釋。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以首次一起練習說明團隊感情，提出如實保存與註記，不把情感價值變成音質最好或正式版本。

examples.en: The recording has emotional weight because it preserves our first attempt at singing together. Let’s keep it as an early rehearsal, not label it as the final performance.
examples.zh: 錄音保存首次一起試唱，所以有情感分量。我們把它作早期排練保存，不標成正式演出。

examples.en: Its sound is imperfect, but the shared beginning gives it emotional weight for the group. We can explain that history in the archive note.
examples.zh: 聲音不完美，但共同起步讓它對團隊有情感分量。我們可在檔案註記說明那段經歷。

takeaways.en: The simple note carried emotional weight because it marked the start of their friendship.
takeaways.zh: 簡單字條標記友誼開始，所以帶情感分量。

takeaways.en: That unfinished sketch has emotional weight for the group that first worked on it together.
takeaways.zh: 那張未完成草圖，對首次一起創作它的小組有情感分量。

brief.meaningEn: Settle in a comfortable curled or relaxed position with something such as a book.
brief.meaningZh: 帶着書等物，舒服地蜷坐或安頓下來。
brief.grammar: curl up with a book; curled up in past; with introduces what accompanies the relaxed sitting, not a reading result.
brief.register: Common curl-up posture/comfort pattern, often used about reading. It does not mean rolling up the book.
brief.boundaryZh: 舒服坐下閱讀，不表示一定睡着、讀完或完全明白內容；需分開姿勢、活動及結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可閱讀有深度的內容，不因姿勢舒服就認定內容一定容易。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然描寫舒服閱讀的場景，保留內容及完成程度。

sources.sentence: She likes to curl up with a mystery novel on Sundays.

listening.en: After putting away the event materials, Mara curled up with a collection of letters on the sofa and read the opening pages before dinner.
listening.zh: 收好活動材料後，瑪拉在沙發舒服地蜷坐，讀一本書信集，在晚餐前看了開頭幾頁。
listening.promptZh: 說話者交代哪種活動？

options.en: Comfortable reading of the opening pages on the sofa.
options.zh: 在沙發舒服地讀開頭幾頁。

options.en: Rolling the letters into a tube without reading them.
options.zh: 把信捲成筒，沒有閱讀。

options.en: Finishing the whole collection before putting away the materials.
options.zh: 收材料前已讀完整本書信集。

options.en: Falling asleep before opening any page.
options.zh: 任何一頁都未開就睡着。

listening.explanationZh: sofa及read opening pages 說舒服閱讀，沒有全讀或睡覺。

reply.promptZh: 收好材料後，瑪拉在晚餐前做了甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What did Mara do before dinner once the materials were put away?

options.en: She read the opening pages of the letters comfortably on the sofa.
options.zh: 她在沙發舒服地讀書信開頭幾頁。

options.en: She curled up with the letter collection and began reading.
options.zh: 她舒服地蜷坐，開始讀書信集。

options.en: She settled on the sofa with the book for a little reading.
options.zh: 她帶書安頓在沙發，讀一會。

options.en: Her break included reading the first part of the collection.
options.zh: 她的小休包括讀書信集開頭。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述已給閱讀場景，不加睡着或讀完。

scene.promptZh: 下雨午後，你帶小說到窗邊椅，舒服地蜷坐看了兩章；故事尚未完。哪句準確？

options.en: I curled up with the novel and read a couple of chapters.
options.zh: 我帶小說舒服地蜷坐，讀了兩章。

options.en: I finished the entire novel, although only two chapters had been read.
options.zh: 雖然只讀兩章，我已讀完整本小說。

options.en: I put the book away without opening it and went straight to sleep.
options.zh: 我未開書便收起，直接睡覺。

scene.explanationZh: 姿勢舒服與讀兩章並存，不代表全完或沒讀。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 curled up with a book 得出？

options.en: The person settled comfortably with the book.
options.zh: 當事人帶書舒服地坐好。

options.en: The person necessarily finished and understood every chapter.
options.zh: 當事人必定讀完並理解每章。

options.en: The rest of the account can explain what was read.
options.zh: 其餘敘述可交代讀了甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 姿勢與閱讀結果是不同資訊。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因角色舒服蜷坐讀書，就想說書的內容很容易；原文只交代姿勢。哪句準確？

options.en: Describe the comfortable position without assuming the book’s difficulty.
options.zh: 描述舒服姿勢，不假定書有多難。

options.en: Use the sofa setting to classify every chapter as easy reading.
options.zh: 用沙發場景把每章判作容易閱讀。

options.en: Remove the comfortable position because challenging books can only be read at a desk.
options.zh: 因難書只能在書桌讀，就刪舒服姿勢。

dialogue.explanationZh: 姿勢不決定內容難度，不應由環境加規則。

speaking.en: I curled up with the book for a while, but I had only reached the second chapter.
speaking.zh: 我舒服地蜷坐讀了一會，但只讀到第二章。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把閱讀姿勢與進度分清。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫給遠方朋友，想約周末各自在家舒服地讀同一短篇，之後語音談最喜歡的一幕；不要求同時讀完或逐題考核。用一至兩句英文發出輕鬆邀請。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以舒服閱讀及之後分享發出邀請，保留各自時間，不把姿勢當已讀完或變成考核要求。

examples.en: Shall we curl up with the same short story at home this weekend, then talk about a favourite scene? We do not need to finish at exactly the same time.
examples.zh: 周末我們各自在家舒服地讀同一短篇，再談喜歡的一幕，好嗎？不需剛好同時讀完。

examples.en: You could curl up with the story whenever you have a quiet moment, and we can share our favourite scenes afterwards.
examples.zh: 你有安靜片刻時，可以舒服地讀那篇故事，之後我們再分享喜歡的場景。

takeaways.en: She curled up with the memoir after the room grew quiet.
takeaways.zh: 房間安靜後，她舒服地蜷坐讀回憶錄。

takeaways.en: I would like to curl up with a story before we discuss it tomorrow.
takeaways.zh: 明天討論之前，我想舒服地坐着讀個故事。

brief.meaningEn: Investigate or examine beyond an initial account to understand more.
brief.meaningZh: 超越初步敘述，進一步調查或檢視以加深理解。
brief.grammar: dig deeper into a question; dug in past; dig a little deeper moderates the degree without creating a new sense.
brief.register: Conventional excavation metaphor for investigation. This lesson is inquiry, not digging soil or taking more money out.
brief.boundaryZh: 深入查問不保證必有陰謀、首個說法一定錯或已找到答案；需合理問題及資料。
brief.misconceptionZh: 查更多應針對未明之處，不等於無限追查或把猜測當證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出具體進一步問題，分開探索行動與已確認結論。

listening.en: The two records gave different dates, so we dug a little deeper by checking the original entries before deciding which date belonged in the display.
listening.zh: 兩份紀錄日期不同，所以我們先查原始條目再決定展示日期，作更深入探究。
listening.promptZh: 深入探究在此是怎樣做？

options.en: Checking the original entries to resolve a specific date discrepancy.
options.zh: 查原始條目，釐清具體日期差異。

options.en: Choosing the more attractive date before reading either entry.
options.zh: 未讀任何條目就選較吸引的日期。

options.en: The different dates referred to the same event and were equally well supported.
options.zh: 不同日期指同一事件，而且證據同樣充分。

options.en: Comparing later summaries settled the discrepancy without using the original entries.
options.zh: 比較後來摘要便釐清差異，沒有用原始條目。

listening.explanationZh: 說話者查原始條目才判斷展示日期，並未先確認兩個日期同指一事或只靠後來摘要。

reply.promptZh: 兩份日期不同的紀錄，令你們怎樣處理？
reply.promptEn: How did you respond to the two records giving different dates?

options.en: We checked the original entries before choosing a date for the display.
options.zh: 我們選展示日期前，先查原始條目。

options.en: We dug a little deeper into the discrepancy rather than guessing.
options.zh: 我們再深入探究差異，而非猜測。

options.en: The disagreement led us to look beyond the summaries.
options.zh: 分歧讓我們不只看摘要。

options.en: We investigated which date the original material supported.
options.zh: 我們查原材料支持哪個日期。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述針對差異的深入核對，不宣稱查前已有答案。

scene.promptZh: 試演有觀眾說不明白角色轉變，你想先問是哪一幕、再看對話銜接，不立即重寫全部。哪句合適？

options.en: We should dig deeper into where the confusion begins.
options.zh: 我們應更深入了解困惑從哪裏開始。

options.en: We should rewrite the whole play before asking which transition confused the audience.
options.zh: 問哪段轉變使觀眾困惑前，我們應先重寫全劇。

options.en: Let us change the ending first and see whether that removes the concern about the character.
options.zh: 先改結局，再看能否消除對角色的疑問。

scene.explanationZh: 先問困惑從哪幕開始及檢查銜接，才是針對問題深入了解；未查就改全劇或結局，未必處理實際問題。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 dug deeper 得出？

options.en: The inquiry went beyond the initial account.
options.zh: 調查超越初步敘述。

options.en: The investigators had already proved a hidden motive.
options.zh: 調查者已證明隱藏動機。

options.en: More detail is needed to know what the inquiry found.
options.zh: 需更多細節才知調查發現甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 深入是過程，不是已證明某結論。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴看日期不一致，就想先寫有人造假；你們還未查原始條目。哪句較準確？

options.en: Dig deeper into the entries before deciding whether the difference is an error, a different event or something else.
options.zh: 先深入查條目，再判差異是錯誤、不同事件或其他原因。

options.en: Could we choose the date that appears in more summaries and leave the original entries unchecked?
options.zh: 可否選較多摘要採用的日期，暫不查原始條目？

options.en: Could we leave both dates out rather than investigate why they differ?
options.zh: 可否不查分歧原因，直接省去兩個日期？

dialogue.explanationZh: 應查原始條目釐清原因；摘要數量或省去日期，都不能回答分歧來自甚麼。

speaking.en: We need to dig a little deeper before deciding what the difference means.
speaking.zh: 判斷差異代表甚麼之前，我們需再深入探究。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清調查及結論。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你做校園午餐減剩食項目，總數下降，但不知道是份量變小還是更多人把食物吃完。你想向小組提議查份量紀錄及做簡短訪問，再決定下一輪活動重點。用一至兩句英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以份量與吃完比例的未明原因提出查證，連到活動決定，不把總數下降直接當某一原因已證實。

examples.en: We should dig deeper before deciding why less food was left over. Let’s compare portion records and ask diners what changed.
examples.zh: 判斷剩食為甚麼減少前，我們應再深入探究。比較份量紀錄，再問用餐者有甚麼改變吧。

examples.en: Digging deeper into the fall in leftovers could help us choose the next activity. The total alone does not tell us whether portions or eating habits changed.
examples.zh: 更深入研究剩食下降，可幫我們選下輪活動。單憑總數不知道改的是份量還是飲食習慣。

takeaways.en: The unexpected reply made us dig deeper into how the question had been understood.
takeaways.zh: 意外回應讓我們更深入查問問題被怎樣理解。

takeaways.en: She dug a little deeper before turning the first impression into a claim in her report.
takeaways.zh: 她再深入探究，才把最初印象寫成報告說法。

titleZh: 以方便輕省的形式呈現

brief.meaningEn: Be presented or available in a form that is easy and convenient, using a wrapping image.
brief.meaningZh: 以包裝意象，描述某事以容易、方便的形式呈現或可取得。
brief.grammar: a skill does not come wrapped in convenience; came for past; wrapped in names the imagined packaging.
brief.register: Creative image from the guide, not a fixed dictionary idiom. Often used with not/every to distinguish value from ease.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是實際包裝，也不表示所有方便事都沒價值，或所有困難必有價值；保留否定範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: not every 意指並非每件都方便，不能改成每件都不方便。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體學習或活動需要支持便利程度，避免由難易直接判價值。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Not every valuable skill comes wrapped in convenience.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 1, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Not every useful skill comes wrapped in convenience: learning to repair this loose joint took several careful attempts, although the short guide made the steps clearer.
listening.zh: 並非每項有用技能都以方便形式呈現：學修這鬆接位需幾次仔細嘗試，雖然短指南令步驟更清楚。
listening.promptZh: 這句否定甚麼，而沒有否定甚麼？

options.en: It rejects the idea that every useful skill is easy, while allowing helpful guidance.
options.zh: 它否定所有有用技能都輕省，但容許有幫助的指引。

options.en: It claims that every convenient guide is useless.
options.zh: 它聲稱每份方便指南都無用。

options.en: It claims that difficult repairs must be valuable regardless of the outcome.
options.zh: 它聲稱不論結果如何，難修都必有價值。

options.en: It says the joint was repaired without any practice.
options.zh: 它說接位毋須練習就修好。

listening.explanationZh: not every 保留部分可方便，although 肯定指南幫助，未以難度保證價值。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你說有用技能未必學得輕省？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say a useful skill may not be easy to acquire?

options.en: This repair needed several careful attempts, even with a clear guide.
options.zh: 即使有清楚指南，這修補仍需幾次仔細嘗試。

options.en: It did not come wrapped in convenience; I had to practise the joint several times.
options.zh: 它並非以方便形式呈現；我需練那接位幾次。

options.en: Understanding the steps helped, but carrying them out still took practice.
options.zh: 明白步驟有幫助，但實際做仍需練習。

options.en: The skill required repeated work rather than only reading the short instructions.
options.zh: 技能需反覆做，不只讀短指引。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給具體練習需要，不把指南有用與需投入當矛盾。

scene.promptZh: 學配音有簡明提示，但掌握停頓仍需聽回錄音、反覆嘗試；你不想貶低提示。哪句準確？

options.en: The skill does not come wrapped in convenience, even though the short tips are helpful.
options.zh: 技能並非以方便形式呈現，儘管短提示有用。

options.en: The helpful tips mean no practice is needed to control pauses.
options.zh: 提示有用表示控制停頓不需練習。

options.en: Every short explanation is worthless because this skill takes time.
options.zh: 因這技能花時間，每份短解釋都無價值。

scene.explanationZh: 提示可有用，仍不把技能練習消除。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 not every skill comes wrapped in convenience 得出？

options.en: Some skills may demand substantial effort to acquire.
options.zh: 部分技能可能需不少努力才能學會。

options.en: Every useful skill is necessarily inconvenient and every easy one worthless.
options.zh: 每項有用技能必定不便，每項容易的都無價值。

options.en: The scope of not every leaves room for different learning experiences.
options.zh: not every 的範圍保留不同學習體驗。

contrast.explanationZh: 並非每項方便，不等於全部不便或方便即無價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把「有用不一定輕省」改成「越困難越有價值」，但你只交代這接位需練習。哪句準確？

options.en: Keep the example of necessary practice without using difficulty alone to rank value.
options.zh: 保留必要練習例子，不只按難度排行價值。

options.en: Remove the guide’s help so the experience sounds as hard as possible.
options.zh: 刪去指南幫助，讓經驗顯得越難越好。

options.en: Judge the repair successful from the number of attempts, without checking the joint.
options.zh: 不查接位，只按嘗試次數判修補成功。

dialogue.explanationZh: 努力可必要，仍需看成果；難度不是價值或成功的單一判準。

speaking.en: Not every useful skill comes wrapped in convenience, but clear support can still help us learn.
speaking.zh: 並非每項有用技能都以方便形式呈現，但清楚支援仍可幫學習。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留並非每項的範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們想把一段家族口述故事整理成雙語小冊，短工具可幫排版，但核對人名及選擇不改原意的譯法仍需時間。你想向同伴說明為甚麼不應只按最快完成來選做法，也承認工具的幫助。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以核名及保留原意的工夫支持說法，同時保留排版幫助，不把方便全貶低或把慢當必定較準確。

examples.en: A careful translation does not come wrapped in convenience: we still need to check the names and meaning. The layout tool can help without doing that work for us.
examples.zh: 仔細翻譯並非以方便形式呈現：我們仍需核對人名及意思。排版工具可幫忙，但不會代做這些工作。

examples.en: Not every worthwhile part of the booklet comes wrapped in convenience, so let’s allow time to review the wording as well as use the helpful tool.
examples.zh: 小冊中並非每項值得做的部分都輕省，所以我們使用有用工具之餘，也留時間檢視措辭吧。

takeaways.en: Learning to listen patiently did not come wrapped in convenience; I had to change how I responded.
takeaways.zh: 學耐心聆聽並不輕省；我需改變回應方式。

takeaways.en: Not every meaningful project comes wrapped in convenience, so we planned time for the work the shortcut could not replace.
takeaways.zh: 並非每項有意義計劃都輕省，所以我們為捷徑不能取代的工作預留時間。

titleZh: 文字密集而不易讀的傳統作品

brief.meaningEn: A traditional work whose tightly packed language or ideas require close attention to read.
brief.meaningZh: 語言或觀念密集，需要仔細閱讀的傳統作品。
brief.grammar: read/discuss a dense traditional text; dense describes the concentration or difficulty, traditional describes the work’s relation to an inherited tradition.
brief.register: Descriptive noun phrase, not an idiom. Dense need not mean bad, and traditional does not alone make a work difficult.
brief.boundaryZh: 需分清文字密度、傳統背景與價值；不因傳統就判難，也不因密集就判無用。
brief.misconceptionZh: 讀得慢可反映需拆解長句或背景，不表示讀者沒能力或每句都不懂。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體閱讀特徵描述作品，並提出合適理解步驟。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The class discussed a dense traditional text together.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 1, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The class worked through a dense traditional text with long sentences and unfamiliar references, pausing to compare a paragraph with the background notes.
listening.zh: 課堂逐步讀一篇傳統作品，長句及陌生典故使文字密集難讀；大家停下，把一段與背景筆記比較。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 dense 的描述？

options.en: Long sentences and unfamiliar references required close reading.
options.zh: 長句及陌生典故需仔細讀。

options.en: The traditional background alone proved that none of the class could understand it.
options.zh: 傳統背景本身證明全班無人能理解。

options.en: The account says the text contained only a few simple everyday phrases.
options.zh: 敘述說作品只有幾句簡單日常用語。

options.en: The notes replaced every paragraph so no original wording was read.
options.zh: 筆記取代每段，沒有讀任何原文。

listening.explanationZh: 長句及典故是已給特徵；停比較不是完全不能讀或全用筆記取代。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼班上需要慢慢讀那篇作品？
reply.promptEn: Why did the class need to read the work slowly?

options.en: Its long sentences and unfamiliar references needed careful attention.
options.zh: 長句及陌生典故需仔細留意。

options.en: It was a dense traditional text that we needed to compare with background notes.
options.zh: 那是文字密集的傳統作品，我們需對照背景筆記。

options.en: We paused to connect the paragraph with information about its references.
options.zh: 我們停下，把段落與典故資料連起來。

options.en: Close reading helped us work through the tightly packed wording.
options.zh: 仔細讀幫我們逐步理解密集措辭。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給具體閱讀需要，不用傳統二字當全部原因。

scene.promptZh: 一篇古典序文用長句、典故及省略背景，你想說需要仔細讀，不批評它無價值。哪句準確？

options.en: It is a dense traditional text that calls for careful reading and context.
options.zh: 它是文字密集的傳統作品，需要仔細讀及了解背景。

options.en: Its traditional origin means its language must be simple and familiar to this class.
options.zh: 它的傳統來源表示語言必定對這班簡單熟悉。

options.en: The need for background notes shows the original has nothing worth reading.
options.zh: 需背景筆記顯示原文沒有值得讀之處。

scene.explanationZh: 特徵支持密集及需背景，不判簡單或沒價值。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 a dense traditional text 得出？

options.en: The wording or ideas may demand close attention.
options.zh: 措辭或觀念可能需仔細留意。

options.en: Its value is settled solely by how difficult it feels.
options.zh: 只按讀來多難，就已決定它的價值。

options.en: Context can explain which language features create difficulty.
options.zh: 情境可說明哪些語言特徵造成困難。

contrast.explanationZh: 描述密度及傳統不是整體價值評分。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因大家需查典故，就說整班毫無能力；你們其實正逐段理解。哪句較準確？

options.en: Describe the unfamiliar references and the reading process, rather than turning difficulty into a judgement of ability.
options.zh: 描述陌生典故及閱讀過程，不把困難變成能力判斷。

options.en: Replace the account of successful paragraph work with a claim that nobody understood any wording.
options.zh: 把逐段理解的敘述，改成沒人懂任何措辭。

options.en: Leave out the background notes so the reading appears effortless.
options.zh: 刪背景筆記，讓閱讀顯得毫不費力。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需支援與逐步理解可並存，不能加完全無能力或抹過程。

speaking.en: We read a dense traditional text slowly, using the notes to clarify unfamiliar references.
speaking.zh: 我們慢慢讀一篇文字密集的傳統作品，用筆記釐清陌生典故。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說明閱讀特徵及做法。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你向朋友借了一篇長句及典故密集的傳統作品，原約周末歸還，但目前只仔細讀完首段。你想誠實說明閱讀需要，請求多借一周；若朋友要用就按原約歸還，不裝作已讀完。用一至兩句英文寫訊息。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以真實進度及長句典故的閱讀需要提出延借，保留朋友需用及原約，不把讀得慢當已讀完或自行延長。

examples.en: This is a dense traditional text, and I have only worked carefully through the first paragraph. Could I keep it for another week, or would you need it back this weekend?
examples.zh: 這是文字密集的傳統作品，我只仔細讀完首段。我可多借一周嗎，還是你這周末需取回？

examples.en: I need more time with this passage from a dense traditional text, so I would like to extend the loan if that suits you. Otherwise I will return it as agreed.
examples.zh: 我需更多時間讀這文字密集傳統作品的段落，所以若你方便，我想延長借期。不然我會按原約歸還。

takeaways.en: The glossary helped us enter a dense traditional text without replacing its original words.
takeaways.zh: 詞庫幫我們開始理解文字密集的傳統作品，而不取代原文。

takeaways.en: We chose one passage from a dense traditional text for a careful discussion.
takeaways.zh: 我們從文字密集的傳統作品選一段仔細討論。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

titleEn: uncover a layer of cultural memory
titleZh: 發掘一層集體文化記憶

brief.meaningEn: Discover an aspect of a community’s remembered past, using an image of revealing a hidden layer.
brief.meaningZh: 以揭開隱藏層次的意象，發現社群記得的過去某一面向。
brief.grammar: uncover a layer of cultural memory; uncovered in past; identify the letters, accounts or practices that reveal it.
brief.register: Expressive archaeology-like metaphor, not a claim that memory is literally buried or that one source represents everyone.
brief.boundaryZh: 一層是局部，不等於完整文化歷史；私人回憶亦需放回相關社群背景，不能從一封信推全體相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 發現值得理解的記憶，不表示內容每項都已核實或過去毫無分歧。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體材料說明文化記憶的一面，保留來源及代表性限制。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: uncovering a layer of cultural memory
sources.sentence: Reading family letters can feel like uncovering a layer of cultural memory.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 1, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The old festival songs helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory: singers described how neighbours once prepared the shared meal, while noting that families remembered the details differently.
listening.zh: 舊節慶歌曲幫我們發掘一層文化記憶：歌者描述鄰里昔日怎樣備共同飯餐，也指出各家庭記的細節不同。
listening.promptZh: 這裏發掘的是甚麼？

options.en: One aspect of remembered communal life, with differences between accounts.
options.zh: 被記得的共同生活其中一面，各敘述有差異。

options.en: A complete record proving every family recalled identical details.
options.zh: 證明每家都記得相同細節的完整紀錄。

options.en: Only the musical pitch, with no connection to past practices.
options.zh: 只有音高，與過往做法無關。

options.en: A future meal plan that had never been connected with older memories.
options.zh: 從未連到舊記憶的未來飯餐計劃。

listening.explanationZh: 歌曲引出共同備餐記憶，也保留家庭差異及局部範圍。

reply.promptZh: 舊節慶歌曲怎樣幫助這次研究？
reply.promptEn: How did the old festival songs help the research?

options.en: They led singers to describe the neighbours’ earlier meal preparations.
options.zh: 它們引出歌者描述鄰里昔日備餐。

options.en: They helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory about shared meals.
options.zh: 它們幫我們發掘與共同飯餐有關的一層文化記憶。

options.en: The songs connected us with remembered practices from the community’s past.
options.zh: 歌曲讓我們接觸社群過往被記得的做法。

options.en: We learned one part of communal life without assuming all families recalled it alike.
options.zh: 我們了解共同生活的一部分，沒有假定每家記憶相同。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給實際記憶內容，不把一層當全史。

scene.promptZh: 整理幾戶老居民的相簿，讓你們看見昔日一起修屋的習慣；仍未訪問其他街區。哪句準確？

options.en: The albums helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory about shared repair work.
options.zh: 相簿幫我們發掘與共同修補有關的一層文化記憶。

options.en: These few albums record every neighbourhood’s history in full.
options.zh: 這幾本相簿完整記錄每個街區歷史。

options.en: The albums have no relation to remembered life because they show everyday work.
options.zh: 因相簿顯示日常工作，所以與被記得的生活無關。

scene.explanationZh: 日常共同做法可屬文化記憶，但幾戶不代表全部街區。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 uncovered a layer of cultural memory 得出？

options.en: A source revealed one aspect of a remembered shared past.
options.zh: 一個來源揭示共同過去被記得的一面。

options.en: All communities must have experienced and remembered it in the same way.
options.zh: 所有社群必定以同樣方式經歷及記得它。

options.en: The source’s perspective still needs to be identified.
options.zh: 仍需辨明來源的視角。

contrast.explanationZh: 一層及某來源的記憶不提供所有群體一致的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把幾位歌者的飯餐記憶寫成全鎮唯一版本，但受訪者自己也說有差異。哪句較準確？

options.en: Name the accounts and keep their differences visible rather than turn them into one universal version.
options.zh: 指明敘述來源，保留差異，不改成全體唯一版本。

options.en: Remove the different details so the account appears to be shared by everyone.
options.zh: 刪不同細節，讓敘述顯得人人相同。

options.en: Discard every account because remembering differently makes communal history impossible to study.
options.zh: 因記憶不同令共同歷史不能研究，就棄掉全部敘述。

dialogue.explanationZh: 記憶差異可成研究內容，不應抹去或全棄。

speaking.en: The letters helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory, not a complete account of every family.
speaking.zh: 書信幫我們發掘一層文化記憶，而非每家完整敘述。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留局部記憶與來源範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替社區步行圖加註，老居民仍用舊渡口的暱稱叫一段小路，官方地圖已用另一名稱。他們敘述昔日等船、送別的經歷，你想加旁註保留這部分文化記憶，並清楚標現用路名，不令訪客迷路。用一至兩句英文說明做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用居民舊地名及渡口經歷說明局部共同記憶，提出保留故事又標清現名的地圖安排，不把回憶當唯一正式路名。

examples.en: The old nickname uncovers a layer of cultural memory about waiting for the ferry and saying goodbye. We can add that story beside the current road name without replacing the navigation label.
examples.zh: 舊暱稱揭開與等渡船及送別有關的一層文化記憶。我們可在現用路名旁加故事，不取代導航標示。

examples.en: Listening to residents helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory behind the path’s older name. Let’s keep it in a note while showing the official name clearly on the map.
examples.zh: 聽居民敘述，幫我們發掘小路舊名背後的一層文化記憶。把它留在旁註，同時在圖上清楚標官方名稱吧。

takeaways.en: The photographs uncovered a layer of cultural memory about the old neighbourhood gatherings.
takeaways.zh: 照片發掘與舊鄰里聚會有關的一層文化記憶。

takeaways.en: Listening to the craft workers helped us uncover a layer of cultural memory beyond the objects themselves.
takeaways.zh: 聽工藝工作者敘述，幫我們發掘物件本身以外的一層文化記憶。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Reading that is easy and relatively undemanding to follow.
brief.meaningZh: 容易跟隨、相對不費神的閱讀或讀物。
brief.grammar: some light reading; the book is/not light reading; reading is uncountable in this phrase.
brief.register: Established collocation using light for low mental demand; it does not measure a book’s physical weight.
brief.boundaryZh: 容易讀不等於沒有價值、沒有情感或內容很短；not light reading 指並非輕鬆讀物，需看實際難度。
brief.misconceptionZh: 同一題材可有不同寫法，不憑小說、傳記等類別就判輕重。
brief.outcomeZh: 能按閱讀要求描述適合當下的讀物，不把容易與低價值混為一談。

sources.sentence: That biography is not light reading.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: That biography is not light reading.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 214, table 1, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: I chose some light reading for the short train journey: a collection of brief stories with straightforward plots, rather than the research chapter that needed close comparison of notes.
listening.zh: 短程火車上，我選易跟隨情節的短篇集作輕鬆閱讀，而非需仔細比較筆記的研究章。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 light reading？

options.en: The stories were straightforward to follow during a short journey.
options.zh: 故事容易跟隨，適合短程途中讀。

options.en: The collection’s paper weight was lower than the research book’s.
options.zh: 短篇集紙張重量比研究書低。

options.en: The stories had been judged worthless because they were easy to read.
options.zh: 故事因易讀被判無價值。

options.en: The research chapter required no attention or comparison.
options.zh: 研究章不需留意或比較。

listening.explanationZh: straightforward plots 說閱讀要求，未比紙重或否定價值。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼選那本短篇集在火車上讀？
reply.promptEn: Why did you choose that collection for the train?

options.en: The plots were easy to follow in the time available.
options.zh: 情節在可用時間內容易跟隨。

options.en: I wanted some light reading rather than a chapter that needed close study.
options.zh: 我想輕鬆閱讀，而非讀需仔細研究的一章。

options.en: The brief, straightforward stories suited the short journey.
options.zh: 簡短而直接的故事適合短程。

options.en: I could enjoy the stories without comparing a set of research notes.
options.zh: 我可享受故事，不需比較一組研究筆記。

reply.explanationZh: 四句描述當下需求，不把易讀判成無用。

scene.promptZh: 一份短文用熟悉用語、情節直接，你想晚餐前輕鬆看一會，卻仍覺得有趣。哪句貼切？

options.en: It makes enjoyable light reading for this short break.
options.zh: 它適合這次小休，讀來輕鬆有趣。

options.en: Its easy style means it cannot offer any enjoyment.
options.zh: 易讀文風表示它不可能帶享受。

options.en: It needs repeated comparison with technical notes before the plot can be followed.
options.zh: 跟情節前需反覆對照技術筆記。

scene.explanationZh: 熟悉直接與有趣可並存，未給技術門檻。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 light reading 得出？

options.en: The material is relatively undemanding to follow.
options.zh: 材料讀來相對不費神。

options.en: The material cannot have any value or emotional interest.
options.zh: 材料不可能有價值或情感吸引力。

options.en: The context can explain why it suits a particular break.
options.zh: 情境可解釋它為甚麼適合某次小休。

contrast.explanationZh: 閱讀要求較低，不代表沒有價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說所有傳記都是 light reading，但你手上的一本需查很多背景。哪句較準確？

options.en: Judge this book’s demands from its language and references rather than the genre label alone.
options.zh: 按這本的語言及典故判閱讀要求，不只看類型。

options.en: Ignore the background checks because the biography label already tells us it is easy.
options.zh: 因傳記標籤已說它容易，就不理背景核對。

options.en: Call the book worthless simply because it takes sustained attention.
options.zh: 只因它需持續專注，就稱書無價值。

dialogue.explanationZh: 類別不保證難易；需留意亦不否定價值。

speaking.en: I wanted some light reading for the break, without assuming that an easy story had no value.
speaking.zh: 小休我想輕鬆讀一會，不假定易讀故事沒價值。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清閱讀要求及價值。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替班級交換書架寫介紹，其中一格放用語熟悉、可短時間讀一段的有趣文章；另一些書要慢讀。你想邀請只剩幾分鐘的同學選輕鬆讀物，不把其他書說成不好。用一至兩句英文寫介紹。
writing.selfCheckZh: 按短時間及熟悉用語介紹讀物，肯定兩類閱讀的不同時間需要，不把輕鬆或費神當價值高低。

examples.en: If you have only a few minutes, this shelf offers some light reading with familiar language and lively ideas. You can save the more demanding books for a longer session.
examples.zh: 若你只有幾分鐘，這格有用語熟悉、想法有趣的輕鬆讀物。較費神的書可留待長一點的時間讀。

examples.en: Try some light reading here when you want a short break. The other shelf has books that deserve more time and attention.
examples.zh: 想短休時，可在這裏試試輕鬆讀物。另一格的書值得多留時間及專注。

takeaways.en: She packed some light reading for the wait between rehearsals.
takeaways.zh: 她帶了些輕鬆讀物，留待排練之間等候時看。

takeaways.en: The short stories made pleasant light reading after a demanding afternoon.
takeaways.zh: 忙碌而費神的下午後，短篇故事成了愉快輕鬆讀物。

titleZh: 內容豐富而值得細味的閱讀

brief.meaningEn: Reading with abundant worthwhile detail, insight or meaning.
brief.meaningZh: 含有豐富而值得細味的細節、見解或意義的閱讀。
brief.grammar: offer/provide rich reading; make for rich reading; explain the kind of richness rather than leaving it a vague compliment.
brief.register: Evaluative collocation using rich figuratively, not a separate idiom or a statement about the reader’s wealth.
brief.boundaryZh: 內容豐富不一定難讀、長篇或昂貴；這是有依據的閱讀評價，不保證所有讀者感受相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 細節多本身不夠，需看對理解有甚麼作用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體細節與見解支持閱讀評價，分開深度、難度及價格。

sources.sentence: The memoir offers rich reading.

sources.sentence: The memoir offers rich reading.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 214, table 1, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The memoir offered rich reading because its small domestic details helped me understand how the family’s choices changed over time, not just what happened next.
listening.zh: 回憶錄的日常小細節幫我理解家庭選擇怎樣隨時間改變，不只接着發生甚麼，所以讀來內容豐富。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 rich reading 的評價？

options.en: Specific details added insight into changing family choices.
options.zh: 具體細節增添對家庭選擇變化的理解。

options.en: The book’s cover price was higher than that of other memoirs.
options.zh: 書的封面定價高於其他回憶錄。

options.en: The reader learned only the order of events, with no further understanding.
options.zh: 讀者只知事件先後，沒有更深理解。

options.en: The detailed account was praised chiefly for covering a longer period than other memoirs.
options.zh: 這份詳盡敘述主要因涵蓋時期比其他回憶錄長而獲讚賞。

listening.explanationZh: 小細節幫助理解家庭選擇變化，才是已給依據；不是價格、僅知順序或涵蓋時期較長。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你覺得回憶錄值得細讀？
reply.promptEn: Why did you find the memoir worth reading closely?

options.en: Its domestic details showed how the family’s choices developed.
options.zh: 日常細節顯示家庭選擇怎樣發展。

options.en: It offered rich reading by connecting small details with changing choices.
options.zh: 它把小細節與選擇變化連起來，帶來豐富閱讀。

options.en: I gained an understanding of the decisions, not just a sequence of events.
options.zh: 我理解到決定，不只知道事件先後。

options.en: The everyday scenes gave me more to think about as the family changed.
options.zh: 家庭變化時，日常場景給我更多思考。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給見解及細節的作用，不只空泛讚美。

scene.promptZh: 一本容易讀的訪談集把不同工作者的選擇並列，讓你理解同一問題可有多種考量。哪句準確？

options.en: It offers rich reading through the different perspectives, even though the language is accessible.
options.zh: 雖然語言易懂，不同視角讓它帶來豐富閱讀。

options.en: The book’s value lies mainly in its demanding technical vocabulary.
options.zh: 書的價值主要在難懂的專門詞彙。

options.en: The book is praised mainly for the number of interviews, rather than what comparing them reveals.
options.zh: 書主要因訪談數量獲讚，而非比較訪談所帶來的理解。

scene.explanationZh: 並列不同工作者的選擇帶來多種考量，支持內容豐富；不是難詞或訪談數量本身。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以單獨支持 rich reading 的評價？

options.en: Details that change how the reader understands a decision.
options.zh: 改變讀者對決定理解的細節。

options.en: A high purchase price with no account of the writing or ideas.
options.zh: 只有高買價，沒有文筆或想法資料。

options.en: Perspectives that invite a thoughtful comparison.
options.zh: 引發仔細比較的視角。

contrast.explanationZh: 價格不是內容豐富的證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把「內容豐富」改成「每句都很難」，但你只說細節有助理解。哪句較準確？

options.en: Keep the insight from the details without adding a difficulty claim we have not made.
options.zh: 保留細節帶來的見解，不加我們未作的難度判斷。

options.en: Would calling it a demanding read express your judgement more precisely?
options.zh: 稱它為難讀的作品，會否更準確表達你的評價？

options.en: Then should we praise the number of details rather than explain what they helped you understand?
options.zh: 那應否只讚細節數量，不解釋它們幫你理解甚麼？

dialogue.explanationZh: 評價的依據是細節帶來的理解，不是未提到的閱讀難度或細節數量本身。

speaking.en: The letters offered rich reading because their small details changed how I understood the journey.
speaking.zh: 書信小細節改變我對旅程的理解，所以帶來豐富閱讀。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用具體見解支持評價。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編兩份園藝日誌的讀書筆記，作者種同一植物卻記下不同觀察，讓你理解光線及照料習慣如何影響各自選擇。你想推薦把兩份並讀，並提一個可比較的問題，不保證人人都有同一結論。用一至兩句英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出不同觀察與選擇的關聯並提出比較問題，不只以篇幅多稱豐富，也不代全體讀者下結論。

examples.en: The two diaries make for rich reading because their different observations reveal how each gardener made choices. I would compare what they noticed about the light.
examples.zh: 兩份日誌不同觀察顯示各園丁怎樣作選擇，並讀內容很豐富。我會比較他們留意光線的哪些方面。

examples.en: Reading the diaries together offers rich reading beyond a simple list of plant care steps. Let’s ask how each writer connected an observation with a decision.
examples.zh: 並讀日誌不只是一份照料步驟表，還帶來豐富閱讀。我們問問各作者怎樣把觀察連到決定吧。

glossary.en: what they noticed about the light
glossary.zh: 他們留意光線的哪些方面

takeaways.en: The paired accounts offered rich reading through their contrasting views of the same event.
takeaways.zh: 兩份敘述對同一事件的不同視角，帶來豐富閱讀。

takeaways.en: Her diary made for rich reading because small observations opened up larger questions.
takeaways.zh: 她的日誌小觀察引出大問題，所以讀來豐富。

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

titleEn: hand everything to you on a plate
titleZh: 不費力就把一切送到面前

brief.meaningEn: Give someone everything ready-made, so they do not need to make the relevant effort themselves.
brief.meaningZh: 把一切現成提供，讓對方不需親自付出相關努力。
brief.grammar: hand everything to someone on a plate; handed in past; pronoun changes with the receiver.
brief.register: Informal established serving idiom. The relevant effort may be reasoning or taking action, not every kind of effort in life.
brief.boundaryZh: 提供支援、示範或合理調整不等於包辦一切；要看哪些判斷及工作仍由本人做。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不包辦不代表完全不幫忙；應分清支持及代做。
brief.outcomeZh: 能具體說明支援與本人責任，避免把任何幫助都貶作現成送上。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: hand everything to you on a plate
sources.sentence: A good lesson should not hand everything to you on a plate.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 2, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The mentor gave us a worked example but did not hand everything to us on a plate: we still had to choose evidence and explain our own conclusion.
listening.zh: 導師給完整示範，但沒有把一切現成送上：我們仍需選證據並解釋自己的結論。
listening.promptZh: 哪些工作仍需學生自己做？

options.en: Select evidence and explain their conclusion.
options.zh: 選證據及解釋結論。

options.en: Copy a supplied final conclusion without choosing evidence.
options.zh: 不選證據，抄已給最終結論。

options.en: Find a way to begin without any example or support.
options.zh: 沒有任何示範支援下自行找起點。

options.en: Remove the mentor’s example because it replaced every decision.
options.zh: 因示範代替每個決定，就刪去它。

listening.explanationZh: 示範已有，still choose/explain 保留學生責任，並非全代或全無助。

reply.promptZh: 有導師示範後，你們仍需做甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What work remained for you after the mentor’s example?

options.en: We had to select the evidence and justify the conclusion ourselves.
options.zh: 我們仍需自己選證據、支持結論。

options.en: She did not hand everything to us on a plate; we still had decisions to explain.
options.zh: 她沒有把一切現成送上；我們仍需解釋自己的決定。

options.en: The example supported the process without supplying our final reasoning.
options.zh: 示範支援過程，沒有提供我們的最終推論。

options.en: We used the guidance while taking responsibility for our own argument.
options.zh: 我們用指導，同時負責自己的論證。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都區分支援及本人判斷，不把示範當全代做。

scene.promptZh: 老師示範一種訪問開場，之後讓你按對象選追問，並說明選擇。哪句準確？

options.en: The teacher supports us without handing everything to us on a plate.
options.zh: 老師支援我們，卻沒有把一切現成送上。

options.en: The teacher has supplied every final question and removed our choices.
options.zh: 老師已提供每條最終問題，除去我們選擇。

options.en: Receiving one example means we have done no thinking of our own.
options.zh: 收到一個示範表示我們沒有自行思考。

scene.explanationZh: 選追問及說明仍由學生做，示範不等於全代。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 handed everything to them on a plate？

options.en: All the answers and decisions were supplied ready-made for this task.
options.zh: 這任務的答案及決定都現成提供。

options.en: A starting example was provided, but learners selected and defended their own evidence.
options.zh: 提供起步示範，但學習者自行選證據並說明理由。

options.en: The relevant work was completed for the recipients rather than by them.
options.zh: 相關工作替接收者做好，不是由他們做。

contrast.explanationZh: 起步支援但保留核心判斷，不是現成包辦。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說只要給詞庫就等於包辦寫作，但學生仍要選詞、組句及表達情境。哪句最好？

options.en: Judge what the glossary supplies and what students still construct, rather than treating every support as a complete answer.
options.zh: 看詞庫提供甚麼及學生仍需組織甚麼，不把每種支援當完整答案。

options.en: Remove all the useful vocabulary so students receive no help at any stage.
options.zh: 刪所有有用詞，讓學生每階段都沒幫助。

options.en: Count the students’ own sentences as supplied answers merely because some words were available.
options.zh: 只因有些詞可用，就把學生自己組的句子算成已給答案。

dialogue.explanationZh: 支援與代寫不同，應看實際保留的組織與表達。

speaking.en: The guide helps me begin without handing everything to me on a plate.
speaking.zh: 指南幫我起步，卻不把一切現成送到面前。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清支援與代做。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你教弟弟安排一次家庭參觀，給他交通圖及開放時間，讓他自己選路線、比較時間並向家人說明。你想鼓勵他有支援地作決定，不要求他完全盲找或替他全選。用一至兩句英文說明做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 交代提供資料但由弟弟比較及解釋決定，避免把支援變全代選，也不把獨立變成沒有必要資訊。

examples.en: I will give him the map and opening times without handing everything to him on a plate. He can compare the routes and explain his choice to the family.
examples.zh: 我會給地圖及開放時間，但不把一切現成送上。他可比較路線，再向家人解釋選擇。

examples.en: The information will help him plan, but I do not want to hand everything to him on a plate by choosing every route myself.
examples.zh: 資料會幫他規劃，但我不想自己選好每條路線，把一切現成送給他。

takeaways.en: The checklist supported the new volunteers without handing everything to them on a plate.
takeaways.zh: 清單支援新義工，卻不把一切現成送上。

takeaways.en: I did not hand everything to her on a plate; she chose the examples and explained the connection herself.
takeaways.zh: 我沒把一切現成送給她；她自己選例子並解釋關聯。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Affect someone’s deep feelings or occupy their thoughts in a compelling way.
brief.meaningZh: 深深觸動情感，或強烈佔據思緒而縈繞心頭。
brief.grammar: a story gets under your skin; got in past; has got in British English; identify the response that supports this sense.
brief.register: Established deep-feeling or interest sense, distinct from the common annoyance sense of the same idiom. The context must make the intended response clear.
brief.boundaryZh: 不一定是惹惱，也不必是喜愛或同意所有內容；需看留在心中的感受及反覆思考。
brief.misconceptionZh: 被作品觸動不代表親歷故事、接受所有觀點或每位觀眾同樣受影響。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用持續反應支持深層觸動，與單純煩擾或事實認同分清。

sources.sentence: A haunting story can get under your skin.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 17, table 2, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The film got under my skin: days later, I was still thinking with sympathy about the sister’s difficult choice, even though I did not agree with everything she did.
listening.zh: 電影深深觸動我：幾天後，我仍帶同情思考妹妹的艱難選擇，儘管不認同她做的每件事。
listening.promptZh: get under my skin 在此用哪種意思？

options.en: Deep emotional involvement that continued after viewing.
options.zh: 看完後仍持續的深層情感投入。

options.en: Irritation at repeated notifications that interrupted the film.
options.zh: 反覆通知打斷電影所帶來的惱怒。

options.en: Agreement with every action the character took.
options.zh: 認同角色每項行動。

options.en: A response that ended as soon as the credits appeared.
options.zh: 字幕一出就結束的反應。

listening.explanationZh: days later及sympathy 支持深層持續影響，even though 留不同意，不是通知煩擾。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你說那部電影一直留在心裏？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say the film stayed with you?

options.en: I was still thinking about the sister’s choice with sympathy days later.
options.zh: 幾天後我仍帶同情思考妹妹的選擇。

options.en: It got under my skin because her decision kept drawing me back emotionally.
options.zh: 她的決定持續牽動情緒，所以電影深深觸動我。

options.en: The story kept affecting me after I had left the cinema.
options.zh: 離開影院後，故事仍影響我。

options.en: I kept reconsidering what her difficult situation meant, without endorsing every action.
options.zh: 我仍重想她艱難處境代表甚麼，沒有贊同每項行動。

reply.explanationZh: 四句用後續反應解釋持續觸動，不把同情當全認同。

scene.promptZh: 一首詩讓你想到離別，隔天仍反覆想它的意象，覺得被深深觸動，而非因它太吵而煩躁。哪句貼切？

options.en: The poem got under my skin and stayed in my thoughts.
options.zh: 詩深深觸動我，一直留在思緒中。

options.en: I was merely annoyed by the volume and did not engage with the poem.
options.zh: 我只因音量惱怒，沒有投入詩。

options.en: The poem stayed with me because I agreed with its view of separation.
options.zh: 詩留在我心中，是因為我認同它對離別的看法。

scene.explanationZh: 持續想意象及被觸動支持深層影響，不是音量惱怒；也沒有資料確定你認同詩的觀點。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由本課故事 gets under your skin 的意思得出？

options.en: It can occupy your feelings or thoughts after reading.
options.zh: 讀後它可持續佔據感受或思緒。

options.en: You must approve of every character’s decision.
options.zh: 你必定認同每個角色的決定。

options.en: The surrounding context distinguishes deep involvement from annoyance.
options.zh: 前後情境把深層投入與惱怒分清。

contrast.explanationZh: 投入、觸動與贊同內容不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因你一直想角色，就寫成你贊同她一切行為；你明說有不同意。哪句澄清最好？

options.en: Keep the lasting emotional response and the disagreement together.
options.zh: 同時保留持續情感反應與不同意。

options.en: Would saying you approved of her choice explain why you kept thinking about it?
options.zh: 說你贊同她的選擇，能解釋為何你一直想它嗎？

options.en: Perhaps the lasting response was irritation with her, rather than sympathy for her situation.
options.zh: 也許持續反應是對她的惱怒，而非對她處境的同情。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已說有同情也有不同意，應保留情感與判斷的區別；不能改為完全贊同或只有惱怒。

speaking.en: The story got under my skin, though I did not agree with every choice the character made.
speaking.zh: 故事深深觸動我，儘管我不認同角色每個選擇。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清情感觸動與贊同。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替展覽留言，一段真實訪談談到長期照顧一座舊花園的耐心；你回家後仍想起說話者的聲音，重新留意自己平日對公共空間的態度。你要描述被觸動及這個反思，不說自己已經歷對方的人生。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以回家仍記聲音及反思空間習慣支持深層觸動，保留訪者人生與自己反應的區別，不混成惱怒或親歷。

examples.en: The interview got under my skin; I could still hear the gardener’s patient voice when I got home. It made me reconsider how I treat shared spaces.
examples.zh: 訪談深深觸動我；回家後仍彷彿聽見園丁耐心的聲音。它讓我重新考慮自己怎樣對待共用空間。

examples.en: Her account has got under my skin and changed what I notice in the public garden. I am reflecting on my own habits rather than claiming her experience as mine.
examples.zh: 她的敘述深深觸動我，改變我在公共花園留意的事。我在反思自己習慣，不把她的經歷當成自己的。

takeaways.en: The quiet scene got under her skin, and she returned to its question long after the play ended.
takeaways.zh: 安靜一幕深深觸動她，戲完很久後，她仍回到其中問題。

takeaways.en: His account got under my skin without making me agree with every conclusion he drew.
takeaways.zh: 他的敘述深深觸動我，卻沒有讓我認同他每項結論。

titleZh: 成為全場最受矚目的亮點

brief.meaningEn: Attract the most attention or admiration in an event or group of performances.
brief.meaningZh: 在活動或一組表現中，吸引最多注意或讚賞，成為亮點。
brief.grammar: a performer steals the show; stole in past, has stolen in perfect; can also describe a striking feature beyond a stage.
brief.register: Established theatre idiom. It describes audience attention or admiration, not theft or ownership of others’ work.
brief.boundaryZh: 最矚目不一定是主角、正式冠軍或唯一有貢獻的人；需場內反應作依據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可讚某亮點，同時承認團隊；不要由掌聲自行加正式評判結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體反應說明亮點，分清關注、名次及貢獻。

listening.en: The brief puppet scene stole the show at the club evening: it prompted the longest applause and was what visitors kept discussing, although the programme had several thoughtful performances.
listening.zh: 社團晚會短短木偶一幕成為全場亮點：它得到最長掌聲，訪客之後一直討論，儘管節目中有幾項用心演出。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 stole the show？

options.en: It drew the strongest described applause and sustained discussion.
options.zh: 它得到已描述最強掌聲及持續討論。

options.en: It was the only performance in the programme.
options.zh: 它是節目唯一演出。

options.en: An official judging panel awarded it first prize.
options.zh: 正式評判團頒首獎給它。

options.en: The scene was discussed because it was the longest item in the programme.
options.zh: 人們討論該幕，是因它是節目中最長的一項。

listening.explanationZh: 最長的是掌聲，並非演出長度；掌聲及持續討論支持全場亮點，未有唯一演出或正式獎項資料。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你稱木偶一幕是全場亮點？
reply.promptEn: Why do you call the puppet scene the evening’s highlight?

options.en: It received the longest applause and stayed in the visitors’ conversation.
options.zh: 它得最長掌聲，也一直被訪客談論。

options.en: It stole the show by drawing the strongest audience response that evening.
options.zh: 它吸引當晚最強觀眾反應，成為全場亮點。

options.en: The audience kept returning to that scene when discussing the programme.
options.zh: 觀眾討論節目時，一直回到那一幕。

options.en: Its reception stood out even among several thoughtful performances.
options.zh: 即使有幾項用心演出，它得到的反應仍突出。

reply.explanationZh: 四句用已描述反應作理由，不加比賽結果。

scene.promptZh: 手作展有多件作品，其中一件會動的紙鳥吸引最多人停留，參觀者離開後仍談它，卻沒有評獎。哪句準確？

options.en: The moving paper bird stole the show.
options.zh: 會動紙鳥成為全場亮點。

options.en: The bird was officially awarded first prize by the judges.
options.zh: 紙鳥正式獲評判首獎。

options.en: The other works were absent from the exhibition.
options.zh: 其他作品沒有在展覽出現。

scene.explanationZh: 最多停留與持續談論支持亮點，不是正式獎或其他全無。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 stole the show 得出？

options.en: It stood out in the attention or admiration it received.
options.zh: 它得到的注意或讚賞特別突出。

options.en: It must have been declared the official winner of a competition.
options.zh: 它必定被宣布為正式比賽冠軍。

options.en: The surrounding account can explain the audience response.
options.zh: 前後敘述可解釋觀眾反應。

contrast.explanationZh: 觀眾亮點與正式評獎不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因木偶一幕最矚目，就刪去其他組員準備燈光及流程的貢獻。哪句較準確？

options.en: Celebrate the scene’s reception while keeping the team’s other work visible.
options.zh: 肯定該幕得到的反應，同時保留團隊其他工作。

options.en: Could we credit the puppet performers alone for the evening’s success?
options.zh: 可否只把晚會成功歸功於木偶演出者？

options.en: Does the longest applause mean the audience also judged the scene’s lighting to be the best?
options.zh: 掌聲最長，是否表示觀眾也評定該幕燈光最好？

dialogue.explanationZh: 觀眾反應突出不表示只有演出者有貢獻，也不能分別推定觀眾對燈光的評價；需保留各項製作工作。

speaking.en: The small scene stole the show, but the whole team helped make the evening work.
speaking.zh: 小小一幕成為全場亮點，但整隊都幫晚會順利進行。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再同時肯定亮點及團隊。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你設計活動路線圖，試看者最欣賞大大的指南針插畫、一直談它，卻忽略真正路線。你想肯定插畫成亮點，再調小圖案、把路線放前，讓地圖能用。用一至兩句英文向設計同伴建議。
writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定插畫吸引最多讚賞，同時按地圖用途調整大小層次，不把吸睛當地圖一定清楚或直接全刪插畫。

examples.en: The compass illustration stole the show in our map trial, but the route needs to be easier to find. Let’s make the picture smaller and bring the directions forward.
examples.zh: 指南針插畫在地圖試看中成為亮點，但路線需更易找到。把圖縮小，將指路資料放前吧。

examples.en: Our lively illustration stole the show, drawing praise away from the practical route information. We can keep its character while giving the route more space.
examples.zh: 生動插畫成為亮點，讚賞焦點離開實際路線資料。我們可保留特色，同時給路線更多空間。

takeaways.en: The short closing song stole the show and became the part everyone wanted to hear again.
takeaways.zh: 短短結尾歌曲成為全場亮點，大家都想再聽那部分。

takeaways.en: Her witty illustration stole the show at the small display.
takeaways.zh: 她機智有趣的插畫在小展覽中成為亮點。

brief.meaningEn: In a stated comparison, deny that the preference or advantage is very large.
brief.meaningZh: 在已說明的比較中，否定偏好或優勢的差距很大。
brief.grammar: I prefer A, but not by a mile; the positive preference remains, while not modifies the exaggerated margin by a mile.
brief.register: Compositional negative use of the informal distance exaggeration by a mile. Learn it within an explicit comparison, not as a freestanding equivalent of not at all.
brief.boundaryZh: 不差很多不等於完全相同、毫無偏好，也不是實際量一英里；要保留前半句偏好。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能只看 not 就把 I prefer A 改成不喜歡 A。
brief.outcomeZh: 能同時表達有保留的偏好及不大的比較差距。

sources.sentence: I prefer the second design, but not by a mile.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 18, table 1, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: I prefer the afternoon rehearsal, but not by a mile: both sessions fit my schedule, and the later one simply gives me a little more time to prepare.
listening.zh: 我較喜歡下午排練，但差距不大：兩場都合時間，較後那場只是讓我多一點準備時間。
listening.promptZh: 說話者的偏好有多強？

options.en: There is a modest preference for the afternoon, while both options work.
options.zh: 略偏好下午，而兩個選項都可行。

options.en: The afternoon option is rejected altogether.
options.zh: 下午選項被完全拒絕。

options.en: The afternoon is overwhelmingly better and the other is unusable.
options.zh: 下午壓倒性較好，另一場不可用。

options.en: The two sessions are being compared by their physical distance.
options.zh: 兩場正按實際距離比較。

listening.explanationZh: prefer 保留選擇，not by a mile及a little 說差距有限。

reply.promptZh: 你較想選哪場排練，差別大嗎？
reply.promptEn: Which rehearsal would you choose, and is the difference large?

options.en: The afternoon, though both fit and the extra preparation time is only a small advantage.
options.zh: 下午，雖然兩場都合，額外準備時間只是小優點。

options.en: I prefer the afternoon, but not by a mile.
options.zh: 我較喜歡下午，但差距不大。

options.en: The later session has a slight edge for me because I can prepare a little longer.
options.zh: 對我而言較後那場略優，因可多準備一點。

options.en: Either would work; I lean towards the afternoon for the extra time beforehand.
options.zh: 兩場都可；因之前多些時間，我稍偏下午。

reply.explanationZh: 四句保留小偏好，金句不表示完全拒絕。

scene.promptZh: 兩條步行路線都合時間，你略喜歡河邊那條，因景色稍有趣，卻不覺另一條差。哪句準確？

options.en: I prefer the riverside route, but not by a mile.
options.zh: 我較喜歡河邊路線，但差距不大。

options.en: I reject the riverside route and strongly favour the other one.
options.zh: 我拒絕河邊路線，強烈偏好另一條。

options.en: The other route is entirely unsuitable for the trip.
options.zh: 另一條完全不適合行程。

scene.explanationZh: 略喜歡與兩條可行吻合，不是拒絕或壓倒性勝出。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 I prefer A, but not by a mile 的意思？

options.en: A has a small advantage in my preference.
options.zh: A 在我偏好上略佔優。

options.en: I favour A overwhelmingly and regard B as unusable.
options.zh: 我壓倒性偏好 A，認為 B 不可用。

options.en: Both may remain reasonable options despite my preference.
options.zh: 儘管有偏好，兩者仍可合理。

contrast.explanationZh: not by a mile 限定差距，不支持壓倒性及不可用。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴只看 not，就把你較喜歡下午寫成拒絕下午；你其實只否定差距很大。哪句澄清最好？

options.en: Keep the afternoon preference and describe its limited strength.
options.zh: 保留下午偏好，說明強度有限。

options.en: Remove the preference because any negative word reverses the entire sentence.
options.zh: 因任何否定詞都反轉整句，就刪偏好。

options.en: Change the small preparation advantage into a claim that the other session cannot work.
options.zh: 把少許準備優點改成另一場不可行。

dialogue.explanationZh: 否定修飾差距，不刪前半句偏好，也不把小優點變絕對。

speaking.en: I prefer this version, but not by a mile; both would serve the purpose.
speaking.zh: 我較喜歡這版本，但差距不大；兩個都能達目的。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留偏好及有限差距。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們替校刊選兩張封面草圖，兩張都清楚呈現題目，你略偏好第二張，因標題空間稍好，但願意聽團隊意見。用一至兩句英文表達有保留的偏好。
writing.selfCheckZh: 表達第二張略優及兩張可用，保留標題空間的小差別與開放態度，不把有限偏好說成全盤否定。

examples.en: I prefer the second cover, but not by a mile; both make the theme clear. Its title space is slightly better, and I am happy to hear the team’s views.
examples.zh: 我較喜歡第二封面，但差距不大；兩張都清楚呈現題目。它的標題空間稍好，我也樂意聽團隊意見。

examples.en: The second sketch is my choice, though not by a mile. I like the little extra room for the title rather than seeing a major problem with the first.
examples.zh: 第二草圖是我選擇，但差距不大。我喜歡多一點標題空間，而非認為首張有重大問題。

takeaways.en: I preferred the revised ending, but not by a mile; the original still had a strong final image.
takeaways.zh: 我較喜歡修訂結尾，但差距不大；原版仍有強烈最後意象。

takeaways.en: The later slot suited me better, but not by a mile.
takeaways.zh: 較後時段較適合我，但差距不大。

brief.meaningEn: If circumstances forced a decision or action that could no longer be put off.
brief.meaningZh: 如果情勢迫使人必須作決定或行動，不能再拖延。
brief.grammar: If push came to shove, I would... for a hypothetical choice; if push comes to shove, we will/can... for a possible future necessity.
brief.register: Informal pressure idiom, not an instruction to physically push someone.
brief.boundaryZh: 假設真被迫選，不表示目前已被迫或沒有其他合理方案；要保留 if 與 would 的語氣。
brief.misconceptionZh: 說出備選不是宣布已預約或已實行，也不一定有吵架。
brief.outcomeZh: 能表達必要時的傾向，分開假設決定及目前事實。

sources.sentence: If push came to shove, I would choose the train.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 18, table 1, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Both halls could suit us, but if push came to shove, I would choose the smaller one because we could manage its setup with the people already available.
listening.zh: 兩個禮堂都可能適合，但真到非選不可，我會選較小的，因現有人手可應付架設。
listening.promptZh: 說話者宣布了甚麼？

options.en: A conditional preference if a decision had to be made.
options.zh: 若必須決定時的有條件偏好。

options.en: A confirmed booking of the smaller hall.
options.zh: 較小禮堂已確認預約。

options.en: A physical confrontation at the hall entrance.
options.zh: 禮堂入口發生肢體衝突。

options.en: A judgement that neither hall can be used.
options.zh: 兩個禮堂都不能用的判斷。

listening.explanationZh: if及would 保留假設，manage setup 給選小理由，未有預約。

reply.promptZh: 若今天非選一個禮堂不可，你會怎樣選？
reply.promptEn: If you had to choose a hall today, what would you do?

options.en: I would choose the smaller one because our current team could set it up.
options.zh: 我會選小的，因現有團隊能架設。

options.en: If push came to shove, I would take the smaller hall for its manageable setup.
options.zh: 真到非選不可，我會因架設可應付而選小禮堂。

options.en: The smaller option is my fallback since it fits the people we have.
options.zh: 小的會是後備選擇，因符合現有人手。

options.en: With no more time to decide, I would favour the one we can prepare ourselves.
options.zh: 若不能再花時間決定，我會偏好能自己準備的那個。

reply.explanationZh: 四句回應假設必要決定，沒有把傾向報成已訂。

scene.promptZh: 兩種報告格式都能用，若限期到仍未定，你會選較容易更新的表格版，尚未交稿。哪句準確？

options.en: If push came to shove, I would choose the table format.
options.zh: 真到非決定不可，我會選表格版。

options.en: The final table version has already been submitted.
options.zh: 最後表格版已交。

options.en: Neither format could possibly meet the report’s needs.
options.zh: 兩種格式都不可能合報告需要。

scene.explanationZh: 假設限期下傾向與尚未交稿吻合，不是已交或全不可用。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 if push came to shove, I would choose A 得出？

options.en: A is a possible choice under pressure to decide.
options.zh: 被迫決定時，A 是可能選擇。

options.en: A has already been chosen and the arrangement confirmed.
options.zh: A 已被選定，安排已確認。

options.en: The speaker is describing a hypothetical necessity.
options.zh: 說話者在描述假設必要情況。

contrast.explanationZh: 條件傾向不等於已落實。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把你必要時會選小禮堂寫成已完成預約；你只在討論後備方案。哪句最好？

options.en: Keep it as a conditional preference and check availability before reporting a booking.
options.zh: 保留為有條件偏好，報預約前先查可用情況。

options.en: Send the preference as confirmation without checking whether the hall is free.
options.zh: 不查禮堂是否空，就把偏好當確認發出。

options.en: Could we leave the setup reason out until we have made the final booking?
options.zh: 可否等正式預約後，才交代架設方面的理由？

dialogue.explanationZh: 備選偏好已有現實的人手理由，可在討論時交代；是否預約及場地可用仍需確認。

speaking.en: If push came to shove, I would choose the simpler plan, but we have not committed to it yet.
speaking.zh: 真到非決定不可，我會選較簡單計劃，但我們尚未承諾採用。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清條件偏好及承諾。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替祖母掃描相簿，有兩種整理法都可用；若周末結束前必須選，你會按年份排，因她可直接核對已有日期，尚未改動檔案。用一至兩句英文向家人說明後備選擇及理由。
writing.selfCheckZh: 保留如果必須選才採用的語氣，給祖母核日期的理由，不把備選說成已改檔或兩種只有一種能用。

examples.en: If push came to shove, I would organise the scans by year because Grandma could check the dates we already have. I have not rearranged the files yet.
examples.zh: 真到非選不可，我會按年份排掃描，因祖母可核對已有日期。我尚未重新排檔。

examples.en: Both methods could work, but if push came to shove, I would use the yearly order to make checking easier for her.
examples.zh: 兩種方法都可行，但真到非決定不可，我會用年份次序，讓她較易核對。

takeaways.en: If push came to shove, we would use the room we can prepare with our current team.
takeaways.zh: 真到非決定不可，我們會用現有團隊能準備的房間。

takeaways.en: If push comes to shove, I can present the shorter version and leave time for questions.
takeaways.zh: 若真到必須採取行動，我可介紹短版，留時間提問。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Remove unnecessary material so the useful content is clearer or more concise.
brief.meaningZh: 刪去不必要材料，令有用內容更清楚或精簡。
brief.grammar: trim the fat from a report/script; trimmed in past; trimming doubles m; identify what is unnecessary for the purpose.
brief.register: Informal editing metaphor, not a comment on a person’s body or a requirement to remove every detail.
brief.boundaryZh: 刪冗不等於越短越好、刪限制條件或所有例子；需保留理解及準確性所需部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 重複可刪，必要理由仍需留；先定目的再判哪些是多餘。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出可刪內容及必留依據，讓精簡服務溝通而非扭曲。

listening.en: We trimmed the fat from the event guide by removing repeated welcome paragraphs, while keeping the access instructions and the changes people needed to know.
listening.zh: 我們刪去活動指南反覆歡迎段落以去冗，保留使用指引及大家需知道的改動。
listening.promptZh: 精簡保留了甚麼原則？

options.en: Remove repetition while keeping information people need.
options.zh: 刪重複，同時保留大家所需資訊。

options.en: Remove access details so the guide contains only greetings.
options.zh: 刪使用細節，讓指南只餘歡迎語。

options.en: Keep the more polished welcome paragraphs and shorten the access instructions instead.
options.zh: 保留較流暢的歡迎段落，改縮短使用指引。

options.en: Remove the change notices because the older instructions are shorter.
options.zh: 因舊指引較短而刪去改動通知。

listening.explanationZh: 精簡針對重複歡迎語，保留實際所需的使用及改動資訊；不只按文筆或篇幅選內容。

reply.promptZh: 你們怎樣讓活動指南更精簡？
reply.promptEn: How did you make the event guide more concise?

options.en: We removed repeated welcomes but kept the necessary instructions and updates.
options.zh: 刪反覆歡迎語，留必要指引及更新。

options.en: We trimmed the fat by cutting repetition rather than useful access details.
options.zh: 我們刪重複而非有用使用細節，以去冗。

options.en: The guide became shorter without losing what people needed to do.
options.zh: 指南縮短，同時保留大家需做的事。

options.en: We kept the changes clear and removed paragraphs that repeated the same greeting.
options.zh: 保留清楚改動，刪重複同一歡迎語的段落。

reply.explanationZh: 四句具體說明去冗及必留資訊，不只追字數。

scene.promptZh: 演講稿同一背景說了三次，時間有限；你刪兩次重複，留一個理解主張必需的例子。哪句準確？

options.en: I trimmed the fat while keeping the example that supports the point.
options.zh: 我刪冗，同時保留支持重點的例子。

options.en: I cut the short supporting example because removing one whole section was quicker.
options.zh: 我刪了簡短的支持例子，因整段刪去較快。

options.en: I kept the most polished repeated background passages and shortened the example instead.
options.zh: 我保留寫得最流暢的重複背景，改縮短例子。

scene.explanationZh: 應刪兩次重複並保留理解主張所需例子；刪得快或文筆流暢，不能取代內容作用的判斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像有效的 trim the fat？

options.en: Remove repeated wording that adds nothing to the purpose.
options.zh: 刪對目的無補的重複措辭。

options.en: Cut a necessary condition so the message is shorter but misleading.
options.zh: 刪必要條件，令訊息較短但誤導。

options.en: Keep the evidence needed to understand the main point.
options.zh: 留理解重點所需的證據。

contrast.explanationZh: 精簡不應令意思失真。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想刪去「需先確認日期」讓邀請更短，但日期確實未定。哪句較準確？

options.en: Keep the pending-date condition and look for repetition elsewhere.
options.zh: 保留日期待確認條件，在其他地方找重複。

options.en: Could we keep only the invitation and leave the date condition for a later message?
options.zh: 可否只留邀請，把日期條件留待稍後訊息才說？

options.en: Would moving the pending-date note to an unlabelled attachment make the main invitation concise enough?
options.zh: 把日期待定備註移到沒有標示的附件，是否足以精簡主要邀請？

dialogue.explanationZh: 日期未定會影響理解及安排，邀請中應清楚保留；延後或藏在未標示附件都容易使人誤會。

speaking.en: We can trim the fat without removing the condition that makes the message accurate.
speaking.zh: 我們可去冗，不刪令訊息準確的條件。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把精簡與準確連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編一段展覽作品說明，原稿反覆形容作品很特別，卻把使用材料及觀眾可怎樣互動的提示埋在中間。你想刪空泛重複，保留這兩項實用內容。用一至兩句英文給修改建議。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出冗贅是反覆空泛讚美，保留材料與互動提示，不因縮短而犧牲觀眾所需資訊。

examples.en: Let’s trim the fat by removing the repeated praise and bringing the materials and interaction tips forward. Visitors need those details to understand the work.
examples.zh: 我們刪反覆讚美以去冗，把材料及互動提示移前。觀眾需這些細節理解作品。

examples.en: We can trim the fat from the caption without losing how the piece was made or how visitors may use it. The repeated claim that it is special can go.
examples.zh: 我們可精簡說明，不刪作品怎樣製作及觀眾可怎樣使用。反覆說它特別的句子可刪。

takeaways.en: The editor trimmed the fat from the introduction while keeping the question that guided the report.
takeaways.zh: 編輯刪去引言冗贅，保留引導報告的問題。

takeaways.en: We trimmed the fat so the instructions were easier to follow, not merely shorter.
takeaways.zh: 我們去冗，讓指引較易跟隨，不只變短。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Prepare an essential basis that later work or progress can build on.
brief.meaningZh: 準備必要基礎，讓後續工作或發展可在其上進行。
brief.grammar: lay/do the groundwork for + noun/-ing; laid or did in the past, has laid/done in the perfect, laying/doing in progress. Both collocations concern preparatory work, not completion of the whole project.
brief.register: Established preparation noun and construction image. Lay the groundwork and do the groundwork are conventional variants; the work supplies a basis for a later stage.
brief.boundaryZh: 有基礎不等於結果已保證、全部完成或不需後續查證；要說明準備支援哪項下一步。
brief.misconceptionZh: 初步資料可有用，仍需按目的檢視；不把起步等同最後方案。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把具體準備連到後續用途，分清基礎、提案及成果。

listening.en: The initial interviews laid the groundwork for our exhibition plan by showing which objects residents could explain, but the team still had to choose a focus and check permissions.
listening.zh: 初步訪問顯示居民能解釋哪些物件，為展覽計劃打基礎，但團隊仍需選焦點及核對許可。
listening.promptZh: 初步訪問完成了哪部分？

options.en: They provided a basis for planning while further choices and permission checks remained.
options.zh: 它們提供規劃基礎，仍有選擇及許可核對。

options.en: They completed the exhibition and settled every permission.
options.zh: 它們完成展覽並辦妥每項許可。

options.en: They replaced the need to decide what the exhibition would focus on.
options.zh: 它們取代決定展覽焦點的需要。

options.en: They established residents’ willingness to lend the objects rather than information for choosing a focus.
options.zh: 它們確立居民願借出物件，而非提供選焦點的資料。

listening.explanationZh: 訪問顯示居民能解釋哪些物件，提供規劃基礎；尚未選焦點或核對許可，也未確立借出安排。

reply.promptZh: 初步訪問對展覽計劃有甚麼幫助？
reply.promptEn: How did the initial interviews help the exhibition plan?

options.en: They showed us which objects residents could help explain.
options.zh: 它們顯示居民可幫解釋哪些物件。

options.en: They laid the groundwork for planning by revealing useful material.
options.zh: 它們揭示有用材料，為規劃打基礎。

options.en: We gained a starting basis before choosing the exhibition’s focus.
options.zh: 選展覽焦點前，我們有了起步基礎。

options.en: The accounts helped us see what might be developed into the display.
options.zh: 敘述幫我們看見哪些可發展成展示。

reply.explanationZh: 四句說明準備用途，不把基礎報作完成。

scene.promptZh: 排練前，小組先核對角色可用時間、整理劇本問題，讓下次能安排集中試演，尚未演出。哪句準確？

options.en: The preparation laid the groundwork for a focused rehearsal.
options.zh: 準備為集中排練打好基礎。

options.en: The group has already tested the whole scene with the available cast.
options.zh: 小組已用現有演員試演整幕。

options.en: The listed script questions are decisions already approved for the next rehearsal.
options.zh: 列出的劇本問題，是下次排練已批准的決定。

scene.explanationZh: 核時間及列問題只是準備，尚未試演，也不表示劇本問題已有決定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 laid the groundwork 得出？

options.en: Useful preliminary work prepared a basis for what follows.
options.zh: 有用前期工作為後續準備基礎。

options.en: The final result is already complete and guaranteed to succeed.
options.zh: 最終成果已完成且保證成功。

options.en: The context can identify the later task the preparation supports.
options.zh: 情境可指出準備支援哪項後續任務。

contrast.explanationZh: 基礎不同於完成及保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把展覽前訪問記成全部許可已批，但只知道可解釋哪些物件。哪句較準確？

options.en: Report the planning basis and list the permissions that still need checking.
options.zh: 報告規劃基礎，列出仍需核對的許可。

options.en: Treat residents’ ability to explain an object as formal permission to display it.
options.zh: 把居民能解釋物件當正式展出許可。

options.en: Could we postpone choosing a focus until all possible display permissions have been obtained?
options.zh: 可否等所有可能的展出許可取得後，才選焦點？

dialogue.explanationZh: 可用訪問資料選焦點並核對相關許可，不能把可解釋物件當許可，也毋須把未選用物件的許可一概當選焦點的前提。

speaking.en: The research laid the groundwork for the plan, but it did not settle every later decision.
speaking.zh: 研究為計劃打基礎，但沒有決定後來每項選擇。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清前期基礎與後續決定。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們想為新同學製作校園路線錄音，先親自走一遍、記下容易混淆的轉角及實際地標，再試寫短稿，尚未錄音。你想向同伴說明這次踏查如何支援後續清楚指路，並提出試聽前仍需核對。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把踏查地標連到後續指路稿，保留找新使用者測試，不把列地標直接當指引已清楚。

examples.en: Walking the route and noting confusing turns laid the groundwork for a clearer audio guide. We still need to test the script with someone new to the campus.
examples.zh: 走路線、記易混淆轉角，為清楚錄音指南打基礎。我們仍需找不熟校園的人試稿。

examples.en: These observations lay the groundwork for the recording by giving us real landmarks to describe. They do not replace a trial of the instructions.
examples.zh: 這些觀察給我們可描述的真實地標，為錄音打基礎。它們不能取代指引試用。

takeaways.en: The short survey laid the groundwork for a more focused discussion.
takeaways.zh: 簡短調查為更集中討論打基礎。

takeaways.en: We are laying the groundwork for the guide by checking the route ourselves.
takeaways.zh: 我們親查路線，為指南打基礎。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Infer an implied meaning from wording and context rather than only the explicit statement.
brief.meaningZh: 根據措辭及情境，推斷沒有直接說出的含意。
brief.grammar: read between the lines; reads/reading; past read has the same spelling but a different pronunciation.
brief.register: Established reading metaphor, also used for speech. Inference should be marked as inference, not treated as direct quotation.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是任意猜心或保證知道動機；要有語句及情境線索，也容許確認或修正。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一句含蓄話可有多種解釋，不把自己的理解冒充對方已明說。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出含意線索並用有保留說法，必要時尊重地確認。

listening.en: When she said she was “still finding her way” with the new task and asked to see an example, I read between the lines that she might welcome some guidance, rather than assume she wanted the task removed.
listening.zh: 她說新任務「還在摸索」並想看示範，我從言外推想她或歡迎指導，而非假定想被撤任務。
listening.promptZh: 說話者作了哪種理解？

options.en: A cautious inference that guidance might be welcome, supported by the request for an example.
options.zh: 根據要示範的請求，有保留推斷她或歡迎指導。

options.en: A direct quotation saying she refused to do the task.
options.zh: 直接引述她拒做任務。

options.en: Proof that the task had already been reassigned.
options.zh: 任務已轉交的證據。

options.en: An inference based only on silence, with no wording or request described.
options.zh: 只根據沉默的推斷，沒有措辭或請求。

listening.explanationZh: might加要示範線索支持有保留理解，沒有拒做或已轉交。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼覺得她可能需要一點指導？
reply.promptEn: Why did you think she might need a little guidance?

options.en: She said she was still finding her way and asked for an example.
options.zh: 她說還在摸索，也要示範。

options.en: Reading between the lines, I thought her request for an example suggested guidance would help.
options.zh: 從言外理解，我覺得要示範的請求顯示指導或有幫助。

options.en: Her wording and request pointed towards support rather than removing the task.
options.zh: 她的措辭及請求指向支援，而非撤任務。

options.en: I treated it as a possible request for help, not a confirmed refusal.
options.zh: 我把它當可能求助，而非已確認拒絕。

reply.explanationZh: 四句以線索支持有保留推斷，不編對方明說。

scene.promptZh: 朋友說聚會「這幾天安排有點滿」，又問可否下周；你覺得或是想改時間，尚未確認。哪句準確？

options.en: Reading between the lines, I think she may prefer next week; I will ask.
options.zh: 從言外理解，我想她或偏好下周；我會問。

options.en: She explicitly said she never wants to meet again.
options.zh: 她已明說永不再見。

options.en: The new meeting time has already been confirmed.
options.zh: 新見面時間已確認。

scene.explanationZh: 安排滿及問下周支持可能改時，未支持永拒或已定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像有根據的 reading between the lines？

options.en: Inferring a possible request from specific wording and context.
options.zh: 從具體措辭及情境推想可能請求。

options.en: Presenting a guessed motive as something the person explicitly said.
options.zh: 把猜測動機當對方明說。

options.en: Checking an uncertain implication with a respectful question.
options.zh: 用尊重的問題確認不肯定含意。

contrast.explanationZh: 推斷需保留與直接說法的區別。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把「可能想看示範」改成她已承認不願做；原話沒有這樣說。哪句較準確？

options.en: Keep the request and the cautious interpretation separate from any claim of refusal.
options.zh: 把請求及有保留理解與拒絕說法分開。

options.en: Should we take the task over for her instead of showing her an example?
options.zh: 我們應否替她接手任務，而不是給她看示範？

options.en: Could we tell the coordinator she wants a different assignment before asking what support she needs?
options.zh: 未問她需要甚麼支援前，可否先告訴統籌她想換任務？

dialogue.explanationZh: 要示範支持可能需要指導，不表示想放棄或換任務；應保留原話並確認需要。

speaking.en: Reading between the lines, I think she may want more time, but I should check rather than assume.
speaking.zh: 從言外理解，我想她或需要更多時間，但應確認而非假定。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再表達有保留推斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你收到合作邀請回覆，對方說「想法有趣，但現在的版本還看不到各人會做甚麼」，並問可否先列分工。你想回信說自己理解對方或需要更具體計劃，提出補資料並確認，而非宣布邀請已被拒。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用對方問分工的線索作有保留推斷，提出補計劃並確認，不把未決改成已拒。

examples.en: Reading between the lines, I think you may need a clearer division of work before deciding. I can send a short plan; would that help?
examples.zh: 從言外理解，我想你決定前或需要更清楚分工。我可寄短計劃，這會有幫助嗎？

examples.en: I have read between the lines that the roles may still be unclear, rather than treating your reply as a refusal. Shall I outline what each person would do?
examples.zh: 我從言外推想角色或仍不清楚，不把回覆當拒絕。我列出各人會做甚麼，好嗎？

glossary.en: the roles may still be unclear

takeaways.en: Reading between the lines, I thought the group might need more detail before agreeing.
takeaways.zh: 從言外理解，我覺得小組同意前或需更多細節。

takeaways.en: She read between the lines but asked a question before treating the implication as certain.
takeaways.zh: 她理解言外之意，但先問問題，才把含意當確定。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

brief.meaningEn: Judging by the outward appearance or an initial view, which may not tell the whole story.
brief.meaningZh: 按外觀或初步所見判斷，未必已看到全部。
brief.grammar: On the surface, + initial impression; can be followed by but/closer inspection to add a deeper distinction.
brief.register: Conventional surface metaphor. It signals a level of observation, not automatic proof that the appearance is false.
brief.boundaryZh: 表面看不一定是假象，也不保證背後有隱藏問題；需查資料才知是否與深入情況一致。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把初步印象直接當確證，也不要因這片語就預設欺騙。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分初看印象及後續核對，保留是否相符的開放性。

listening.en: On the surface, the two workshop plans looked alike, but a closer look showed that one included time for questions while the other ended straight after the demonstration.
listening.zh: 表面看兩個工作坊計劃相似，但仔細看才知一個留提問時間，另一個示範後就結束。
listening.promptZh: 表面與仔細查看有甚麼分別？

options.en: The plans initially looked similar, but their question time differed.
options.zh: 初看計劃相似，但提問時間不同。

options.en: The plans were identical in every detail after checking.
options.zh: 核對後兩計劃每項細節都相同。

options.en: The first plan deliberately hid its timing from the organiser.
options.zh: 首個計劃故意向主辦者隱藏時間。

options.en: The initial impression alone established which workshop taught better.
options.zh: 初步印象本身確定哪個教得較好。

listening.explanationZh: looked alike 對比提問差別，未有意圖或教學成效比較。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你說兩個計劃不完全一樣？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say the two plans are not exactly the same?

options.en: Only one leaves time for questions after the demonstration.
options.zh: 只有一個在示範後留提問時間。

options.en: They look alike on the surface, but their question time differs.
options.zh: 它們表面相似，但提問時間不同。

options.en: A closer check showed a difference in how the session ends.
options.zh: 仔細核對顯示環節結束方式不同。

options.en: The demonstration is not followed by the same opportunity to ask questions in both plans.
options.zh: 兩個計劃示範後的提問機會不同。

reply.explanationZh: 四句指出已給細節差異，不猜隱瞞或成效。

scene.promptZh: 兩張地圖初看同樣清楚，放大後發現一張有無障礙路線，另一張沒有；你尚未問製圖者原因。哪句準確？

options.en: On the surface the maps look similar, but only one marks the accessible route.
options.zh: 地圖表面相似，但只有一張標無障礙路線。

options.en: The initial similarity proves every route detail matches.
options.zh: 初看相似證明每項路線細節相同。

options.en: The missing route proves the designer deliberately excluded visitors.
options.zh: 缺路線證明設計者故意排除訪客。

scene.explanationZh: 初看與細節可不同，未有故意動機資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 on the surface 得出？

options.en: The speaker is referring to an outward or initial view.
options.zh: 說話者提及外觀或初步所見。

options.en: The initial appearance must be false and deliberately deceptive.
options.zh: 初步外觀必定錯，而且故意欺騙。

options.en: Further evidence may confirm or complicate the first impression.
options.zh: 更多證據可確認或補充初步印象。

contrast.explanationZh: 片語標層次，不自行證明真假或意圖。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴見你說「表面相似」，就想宣布主辦者有意隱瞞；你只發現提問時間不同。哪句最好？

options.en: Describe the timing difference and ask about it without adding an unverified motive.
options.zh: 描述時間差別並查問，不加未核實動機。

options.en: The organiser left out question time in order to avoid difficult questions.
options.zh: 主辦者省去提問時間，是為避開難答的問題。

options.en: Could we describe the plans as interchangeable because the demonstrations are similar?
options.zh: 示範相似，可否就把兩個計劃說成可互相替換？

dialogue.explanationZh: 提問時間不同值得交代，但沒有資料判定想迴避問題，也不能只憑示範相似忽略差別。

speaking.en: On the surface, the plans look similar, but I want to compare what each one includes.
speaking.zh: 表面看計劃相似，但我想比較各自包含甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把初看與核對連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你整理兩篇小組成員的反思，初看都說活動成功，細讀才知一篇看重完成作品，另一篇看重大家有機會發言。你想在摘要並列兩種準則，再問下次應怎樣共同評估，不判誰說謊。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用兩種成功準則說明初看一致與細讀差別，提出共同評估，不由差異加說謊或只留一種價值。

examples.en: On the surface, both reflections call the activity a success, but they use different criteria. We should compare the finished work with the chance each person had to contribute.
examples.zh: 表面看兩篇反思都說活動成功，但所用準則不同。我們應把完成作品與各人發言貢獻機會並列比較。

examples.en: The accounts agree on the surface, yet one focuses on the product and the other on participation. Let’s discuss how to assess both next time.
examples.zh: 兩份敘述表面一致，但一份重成果，另一份重參與。討論下次怎樣同時評估兩者吧。

takeaways.en: On the surface, the reply seemed final, but the last sentence invited another proposal.
takeaways.zh: 表面看回覆似乎已定，但最後一句邀請另一方案。

takeaways.en: The activities looked similar on the surface, so we checked their aims before comparing them.
takeaways.zh: 活動表面相似，所以比較前我們先查各自目標。

titleEn: stand on its own two feet

target.pattern: (?:\bstand(?:s|ing)? on (?:my|your|his|her|our|their|its) own two feet\b|\bstood on (?:my|your|his|her|our|their|its) own two feet\b)|(?:\b(?:stand|stands|standing|stood) (?:steadily )?on their own (?:two )?feet(?: academically)?\b)

brief.meaningEn: Function or succeed independently rather than relying entirely on another person or work.
brief.meaningZh: 憑自身條件運作或立足，不全靠另一人或作品。
brief.grammar: stand on one's own (two) feet; steadily can strengthen independence and academically can specify the domain. Stand, stands, standing and stood are possible forms.
brief.register: Established body idiom productively applied to people’s independence and to a work that can be appreciated without another work.
brief.boundaryZh: 獨立不等於從沒幫助、完全孤立或所有方面都精通；作品可有來源，仍需自身足夠清楚。
brief.misconceptionZh: 人可逐步學自理，也可合理求助；作品可改編而不要求觀眾先讀原作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明獨立所指範圍，分清支援、依賴及完全隔絕。
