listening.en: The adaptation needed to stand on its own two feet: viewers who had not read the novel should still understand the central conflict from the film itself.
listening.zh: 改編作品需憑自身立足：未讀小說的觀眾，仍應從電影本身明白核心衝突。
listening.promptZh: 作品的獨立性在此指甚麼？

options.en: The film provides enough for viewers to understand without first reading the novel.
options.zh: 觀眾不先讀小說，也可由電影取得足夠理解。

options.en: The film must have no connection with any earlier work.
options.zh: 電影必須與任何較早作品都無關。

options.en: Viewers must know the novel before following the conflict.
options.zh: 觀眾先知小說才能跟衝突。

options.en: The film was intended chiefly as a recap for viewers already familiar with the novel.
options.zh: 電影主要為熟悉小說的觀眾重述情節。

listening.explanationZh: 電影本身需讓未讀小說者理解衝突，不是只供熟悉原作的人重溫，也不表示不能改編。

reply.promptZh: 你希望沒讀過原著的觀眾能怎樣看這部電影？
reply.promptEn: How should viewers who have not read the novel be able to watch the film?

options.en: They should be able to follow the central conflict from the film itself.
options.zh: 他們應能從電影本身跟上核心衝突。

options.en: The film should stand on its own two feet rather than depend on prior knowledge of the novel.
options.zh: 電影應憑自身立足，而非依賴先知小說。

options.en: They should not need to read the book just to understand the main issue.
options.zh: 他們不應只為明白主要問題就需先讀書。

options.en: The adaptation needs to supply its own clear account of the conflict.
options.zh: 改編需自行清楚交代衝突。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給理解上的獨立，不要求沒有來源或相同評價。

scene.promptZh: 展覽短片摘自長訪問，但想讓未聽全訪問的人也明白說話者及事件背景。哪句準確？

options.en: The short film should stand on its own two feet with enough context for new viewers.
options.zh: 短片應給新觀眾足夠背景，憑自身立足。

options.en: A reference to the full interview can take the place of identifying the speaker in the clip.
options.zh: 註明完整訪問來源，可取代在短片交代說話者身分。

options.en: New viewers must hear the entire interview before they can follow any part of the short film.
options.zh: 新觀眾必須先聽全訪問才能跟短片任何部分。

scene.explanationZh: 短片需自身交代說話者及事件背景；引向完整訪問或要求先聽全文，未讓新觀眾憑短片理解。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 stand on their own two feet 得出？

options.en: They function with a meaningful degree of independence in the relevant context.
options.zh: 他們在相關範圍內能有相當程度獨立。

options.en: They must reject every form of help and never depend on anyone for anything.
options.zh: 他們必須拒絕所有幫助，任何事永不依靠人。

options.en: The context should identify what they can now handle for themselves.
options.zh: 情境應指出他們現可自行處理甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 獨立需有範圍，不等於完全拒助。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「能自己安排生活，就不能再問人意見」，但你想分清獨立與拒助。哪句最好？

options.en: You can stand on your own two feet while seeking advice; the final decision can still be yours.
options.zh: 你可以一邊徵求意見，一邊保持獨立；最後仍由你自己決定。

options.en: If my friend chooses the final option for me, that is still the same as making the decision myself.
options.zh: 若朋友替我選最後方案，仍等同我自己作決定。

options.en: Should I avoid asking about the details so the decision is entirely mine?
options.zh: 為了讓決定完全由我作，我應否避免向人問細節？

dialogue.explanationZh: 求取資料或意見不等於把最後選擇交給別人；可了解細節再自行決定，不需為獨立而拒絕資訊。

speaking.en: The project can stand on its own two feet while still acknowledging the support that helped it begin.
speaking.zh: 項目能憑自身立足，同時仍承認起步時的支援。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清獨立與否認幫助。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你準備離家參加短期交流，已學自己洗衣及安排每天出門時間，仍會問同伴不熟的交通資訊。你想寫給家人，說明在這些日常事務逐步獨立，不承諾從此毋須任何幫助。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以洗衣及時間安排支持日常獨立，保留查交通的合理求助，不把獨立擴成任何事都不需人。

examples.en: I am learning to stand on my own two feet by handling my laundry and planning when to leave each day. I can still ask for help with unfamiliar routes.
examples.zh: 我正透過自己洗衣、安排每天出門時間學獨立。我仍可在不熟路線上求助。

examples.en: Standing on my own two feet does not mean refusing advice; I want to manage these daily tasks while checking transport details I do not know.
examples.zh: 獨立不表示拒絕意見；我想自行處理這些日常任務，同時核對不熟的交通細節。

takeaways.en: The film stood on its own two feet by giving new viewers the context they needed.
takeaways.zh: 電影給新觀眾所需背景，憑自身立足。

takeaways.en: After guided practice, the learners could stand on their own feet academically when checking sources.
takeaways.zh: 經過指導練習後，學員核對資料來源時，已能在學習上獨立判斷。

brief.meaningEn: Extremely high in degree or amount, using an exaggerated height image.
brief.meaningZh: 以誇張高度意象，形容程度或數量高得驚人。
brief.grammar: expectations/prices/confidence are sky-high; hyphen is conventional; specify what is high and the context.
brief.register: Informal emphatic description, often figurative. It conveys a strong degree, not an exact measured amount.
brief.boundaryZh: 期望極高不保證表現成功，價格極高亦不直接判品質；需分清所形容項目及依據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能把期待、結果、費用等不同量混成同一事實，也不自行補精確數字。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用有依據的強程度描述，保留量度及結果限制。

listening.en: Expectations were sky-high after the preview received so much praise, but the cast still had to perform the full play the following evening.
listening.zh: 預演大受讚賞後，期望高得驚人，但演員仍需在翌晚演整齣戲。
listening.promptZh: sky-high 形容甚麼，而不是甚麼？

options.en: Very strong expectations before the full performance, not a result already achieved.
options.zh: 正式演出前極高期望，而非已達結果。

options.en: A full performance that had already been completed and reviewed.
options.zh: 已完成並已評論的正式演出。

options.en: An exact numerical score awarded to every actor.
options.zh: 給每位演員的精確數字分數。

options.en: The stage’s physical height above the audience.
options.zh: 舞台比觀眾高的實際高度。

listening.explanationZh: expectations是對象，still had to perform保留未來演出，沒有數字或台高。

reply.promptZh: 預演獲很多讚賞後，大家對正式演出有甚麼期待？
reply.promptEn: What were people expecting after the much-praised preview?

options.en: They expected a great deal before seeing the full play.
options.zh: 未看全劇前，他們期待很高。

options.en: Expectations were sky-high, although the full performance was still ahead.
options.zh: 期望高得驚人，儘管正式演出仍未到。

options.en: The praise had raised hopes to a very high level.
options.zh: 讚賞令期望升到很高程度。

options.en: People were looking forward to an impressive performance rather than commenting on one already finished.
options.zh: 大家期待精彩演出，不是在評論已完的那場。

reply.explanationZh: 四句描述未來期望，不代替實際結果。

scene.promptZh: 活動前報名者對新遊戲非常期待，整天問何時能試，遊戲尚未開始。哪句準確？

options.en: Anticipation is sky-high before the first trial.
options.zh: 首次試玩前，期待高得驚人。

options.en: The high anticipation confirms that the trial has already succeeded.
options.zh: 高期待確認試玩已成功。

options.en: The visitors have completed their reviews of the finished trial.
options.zh: 訪客已完成對已結束試玩的評論。

scene.explanationZh: 強烈期待可描述，未開始不能報成功或完成評論。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 expectations were sky-high 得出？

options.en: The expectations were extremely high in the context.
options.zh: 情境中的期望極高。

options.en: The expected result has already been achieved.
options.zh: 期待結果已達成。

options.en: Actual performance will require separate evidence.
options.zh: 實際表現需另有證據。

contrast.explanationZh: 期望與成果不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想用預演後的高期望直接寫正式演出已成功，但正式場明晚才開始。哪句最好？

options.en: Describe the strong expectations and wait for the performance before reporting its result.
options.zh: 描述強烈期望，待演出後才報結果。

options.en: Use the audience’s hopes as the completed performance review.
options.zh: 把觀眾期望當已完成演出評論。

options.en: Delete the preview praise because future results are not yet known.
options.zh: 因未來結果未知，就刪預演讚賞。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已知讚賞可解釋期望，仍不取代未發生結果。

speaking.en: Expectations are sky-high, but we still need to see how the performance goes.
speaking.zh: 期望高得驚人，但仍需看演出怎樣。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清期望與實績。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你收到班級紀念冊印製報價，比已了解的其他同類報價高很多，覺得價格高得驚人；尚未核對它是否多含特別裝訂。你想寫給同伴，先描述費用感受並提議查所含項目，不自行判定店家欺騙。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 按同類比較說價格極高，提出核對裝訂及內容，不加數字、品質結論或店家動機。

examples.en: The price seems sky-high compared with the other quotes we have seen. Let’s check whether the special binding is included before deciding what the difference means.
examples.zh: 與看過的其他報價相比，這價錢看來高得驚人。判差別代表甚麼前，先查是否包括特別裝訂吧。

examples.en: This quote looks sky-high to me, but we still need to compare what each service provides. The amount alone does not explain the reason.
examples.zh: 這報價對我而言高得驚人，但仍需比較各服務提供甚麼。金額本身不解釋原因。

takeaways.en: Her hopes were sky-high when the first rehearsal went well.
takeaways.zh: 首排順利時，她期望高得驚人。

takeaways.en: The quoted cost looked sky-high, so we compared the included work before responding.
takeaways.zh: 所報費用看來高得驚人，所以回覆前我們比較所含工作。

titleZh: 削弱吸引力或推進勢頭

brief.meaningEn: Reduce a work’s appeal or a person’s or group’s momentum, as if removing the wind driving it forward.
brief.meaningZh: 像抽走推動力般，削弱作品的吸引力，或個人、團隊的勢頭。
brief.grammar: Take/took the wind out of a mystery or activity; the fuller idiom take the wind out of someone’s sails can describe lost confidence or momentum. State what event caused the setback and which response weakened.
brief.register: Conventional wind-and-sails metaphor, with a flexible shortened object-focused form; a reviewer may use it for lost suspense, while a colleague may use the sails form for a group’s setback.
brief.boundaryZh: 削弱懸念或勢頭，不表示作品全無價值、團隊已停止行動，亦不指實際風力；需交代失去的是甚麼。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要由一次失望推斷所有觀眾不喜歡作品，或整個團隊無法恢復；應說明影響範圍及後續。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體事件說明吸引力或推進勢頭如何減弱，並保留程度及後續行動。

listening.en: Knowing the solution in advance took the wind out of the mystery for me: I still admired the performances, but I no longer felt the same suspense about who had left the note.
listening.zh: 預先知道答案，削弱謎案對我的吸引力：我仍欣賞演出，但不再對誰留字條有同樣懸念。
listening.promptZh: 這裏削弱了甚麼，同時保留甚麼？

options.en: The speaker’s suspense decreased while appreciation of the performances remained.
options.zh: 說話者懸念減少，同時仍欣賞演出。

options.en: The revealed solution reduced the speaker’s admiration for the acting.
options.zh: 答案揭露使說話者較少欣賞演技。

options.en: The solution became more uncertain after it was revealed.
options.zh: 答案揭露後變得更不確定。

options.en: The speaker had not encountered any information about the ending.
options.zh: 說話者沒接觸任何結局資訊。

listening.explanationZh: in advance及less suspense說已知答案的影響，still admired保留其他欣賞。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼預知答案影響你看謎案？
reply.promptEn: Why did knowing the solution affect your experience of the mystery?

options.en: I no longer had the same suspense about who left the note.
options.zh: 我不再對誰留字條有同樣懸念。

options.en: It took the wind out of the mystery for me by removing that uncertainty.
options.zh: 它除去那份不確定，削弱謎案對我的吸引力。

options.en: I could admire the acting, but the question driving my curiosity had already been answered.
options.zh: 我可欣賞演技，但帶動好奇的問題已被解答。

options.en: Knowing the solution changed the part of the experience that depended on discovery.
options.zh: 知道答案改變了體驗中依賴發現的部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四句說明個人懸念減弱，不抹演出價值。

scene.promptZh: 遊戲中途，旁人直接告訴你最終密碼，你仍喜歡場景設計，卻少了自己解謎的期待。哪句貼切？

options.en: The revealed code took the wind out of the puzzle for me, though I still enjoyed the setting.
options.zh: 密碼被揭削弱解謎對我的吸引力，雖然我仍喜歡場景。

options.en: The revealed code restored the uncertainty about the final answer.
options.zh: 揭露密碼恢復對最後答案的不確定。

options.en: I stopped appreciating every aspect of the design, according to the account.
options.zh: 按敘述，我不再欣賞設計任何方面。

scene.explanationZh: 揭答案削弱解謎期待，但場景仍喜歡，不能讀成全部否定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由本課 took the wind out of the mystery 得出？

options.en: A feature that drove the speaker’s interest was weakened.
options.zh: 帶動說話者興趣的某部分被削弱。

options.en: The speaker now considers the acting less skilful because the mystery was spoiled.
options.zh: 說話者因謎案被劇透，現在認為演技較差。

options.en: The context can show whether other aspects remained enjoyable.
options.zh: 情境可顯示其他方面是否仍有趣。

contrast.explanationZh: 此處削弱的是解謎懸念，不能轉成對演技的負評；仍欣賞表演已明說。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把你懸念減少寫成你不喜歡演技，但你仍欣賞表演。哪句較準確？

options.en: The early reveal took the wind out of the suspense for me, but I still admired the acting.
options.zh: 過早揭曉令我少了懸念，但我仍欣賞演技。

options.en: Use the missing uncertainty as your review of the actors’ skill.
options.zh: 把失去不確定感當對演員技巧的評論。

options.en: Perhaps the script made the answer too easy to guess, rather than the advance information changing your experience.
options.zh: 也許是劇本讓答案太容易猜，而非預知資料改變你的體驗。

dialogue.explanationZh: 預先知道答案削弱了懸念，卻沒有抹去對演技的欣賞；要分清兩種反應。

speaking.en: The early reveal took the wind out of the story for me, but I still valued the performances.
speaking.zh: 太早揭露削弱故事對我的吸引力，但我仍重視演出。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清受影響及仍欣賞的部分。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替展覽設計互動尋找線索，開場海報卻把最後對應答案全列出，試玩者說未開始就已知道結局。你想請同伴把完整答案移到最後可選揭示區，保留開場玩法說明。用一至兩句英文解釋修改目的。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以先知答案連到失去探索期待，提出答案與起步指引分開，不刪必要玩法，也不宣稱所有訪客都不喜歡。

examples.en: Listing every answer on the opening poster takes the wind out of the trail before visitors begin. Let’s keep the instructions there and move the solutions to an optional reveal at the end.
examples.zh: 開場海報列每個答案，讓觀眾未開始已少了線索遊戲吸引力。保留玩法，把答案移到最後可選揭示區吧。

examples.en: The answer sheet took the wind out of the activity for our testers, so we should separate it from the starting instructions. Visitors can choose to consult it later.
examples.zh: 答案表削弱試玩者對活動的興趣，所以應與起步指引分開。訪客之後可選擇查看。

takeaways.en: The early summary took the wind out of the ending for me by revealing the final choice.
takeaways.zh: 太早摘要揭最後選擇，削弱結尾對我的吸引力。

takeaways.en: Losing the first sponsor took the wind out of the youth orchestra’s sails, but the members found a smaller hall and kept rehearsing.
takeaways.zh: 失去首位贊助者削弱了青年樂團的勢頭，但團員找到較小的場地，繼續排練。

titleEn: go in with an open mind

brief.meaningEn: Begin an experience willing to consider what it offers rather than fixing the judgement in advance.
brief.meaningZh: 開始接觸時，願意考慮實際內容，不先定下評價。
brief.grammar: go in with an open mind; went in in past; with an open mind describes attitude, not a duty to approve.
brief.register: Natural go-in frame combined with the established open-mind expression. Context supplies the experience being entered.
brief.boundaryZh: 開放不等於放棄判斷、相信一切或必定喜歡；可在理解後有保留或不同意。
brief.misconceptionZh: 既有知識可保留，但不讓未查的標籤取代當下觀察。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明先看實際內容再評價的態度，保留批判及個人選擇。

sources.expression: go in with an open mind
sources.sentence: Readers should go in with an open mind.

listening.en: I went in with an open mind despite the unfamiliar style, listening to the whole piece before deciding which parts worked for me and which did not.
listening.zh: 儘管風格陌生，我仍抱開放心態接觸，聽完整首後才決定哪些部分適合我、哪些不。
listening.promptZh: 開放心態在此指甚麼？

options.en: Consider the whole piece before making a mixed judgement.
options.zh: 先考慮整首，再作有好有保留的評價。

options.en: Promise to like every part before hearing it.
options.zh: 未聽就承諾喜歡每部分。

options.en: Dismiss the style without listening because it was unfamiliar.
options.zh: 因風格陌生，未聽就否定。

options.en: Avoid making any judgement even after listening.
options.zh: 即使聽後亦避免任何判斷。

listening.explanationZh: 先聽再分哪些合用，說開放不等於全喜歡或永不判斷。

reply.promptZh: 面對陌生風格，你怎樣聽那首作品？
reply.promptEn: How did you approach the piece in an unfamiliar style?

options.en: I listened to the whole piece before judging what worked for me.
options.zh: 我先聽整首，再判哪些適合我。

options.en: I went in with an open mind rather than reject it in advance.
options.zh: 我抱開放心態接觸，而非預先拒絕。

options.en: I gave it a fair hearing while allowing myself a mixed response afterwards.
options.zh: 我公平地聽，同時容許之後有好有保留。

options.en: I waited for the actual experience instead of deciding from the style label alone.
options.zh: 我先實際體驗，不只按風格標籤決定。

reply.explanationZh: 四句說明先接觸後評，不保證全贊同。

scene.promptZh: 朋友邀你看未接觸過的舞蹈，你決定先看動作及主題再談感受，沒有承諾喜歡全部。哪句準確？

options.en: I will go in with an open mind and form my response after watching.
options.zh: 我會抱開放心態接觸，看後再形成感受。

options.en: I have already decided that every part deserves praise.
options.zh: 我已決定每部分都值得讚。

options.en: The unfamiliar style is enough reason to reject the performance without seeing it.
options.zh: 風格陌生已足以讓我不看便否定。

scene.explanationZh: 先看再形成回應符合開放，不是預定讚或貶。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 go in with an open mind？

options.en: Consider the experience before settling a judgement.
options.zh: 先考慮體驗，再定評價。

options.en: Fix the negative verdict from a label and ignore what actually happens.
options.zh: 按標籤定負評，不理實際發生甚麼。

options.en: Remain willing to revise an expectation based on what is observed.
options.zh: 願按觀察修正預期。

contrast.explanationZh: 預定判決又不理觀察，是封閉而非開放。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「既然開放，就不能對任何部分有保留」，但你已仔細看完整場。哪句較準確？

options.en: An open approach can lead to a thoughtful disagreement or a mixed response.
options.zh: 開放接觸後可有深思的不同意或有保留回應。

options.en: Treat your initial willingness as a promise to approve of every later detail.
options.zh: 把起初願接觸當承諾認同往後每項細節。

options.en: Replace the reasons from the performance with a general label about its style.
options.zh: 用對風格的籠統標籤取代表演中的理由。

dialogue.explanationZh: 開放與有根據評價可並存，不是必須稱好。

speaking.en: I want to go in with an open mind, then explain my response using what I actually notice.
speaking.zh: 我想先抱開放心態接觸，再按實際留意的事解釋反應。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把開放及有根據評價連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：同學提出新的分組討論方法，你原先不習慣，但願意試一輪，留意是否每人有機會發言，再向小組說哪些需調整。用一至兩句英文表達試行態度，不預先保證成功或全部接受。
writing.selfCheckZh: 表明願試再按發言機會評估，保留改善空間，不把開放變成保證成功或預定全拒。

examples.en: I will go in with an open mind and try one round before judging the new discussion method. I want to notice who gets a chance to speak and what needs adjusting.
examples.zh: 我會抱開放心態試一輪，再判新討論方法。我想留意誰有發言機會，以及甚麼需調整。

examples.en: Let’s go in with an open mind, without promising that every part will work. We can use the first round to collect specific observations.
examples.zh: 我們抱開放心態試，不承諾每部分都有效。首輪可用來收集具體觀察。

takeaways.en: She went in with an open mind and found that her first expectation needed revising.
takeaways.zh: 她抱開放心態接觸，發現最初預期需修正。

takeaways.en: We can go in with an open mind while still asking careful questions.
takeaways.zh: 我們可抱開放心態接觸，同時仍仔細提問。

brief.meaningEn: Provide information missing from an existing account or understanding.
brief.meaningZh: 為已有敘述或理解，補充缺少的資料。
brief.grammar: an interview fills in the gaps in a report; filled in in past; explain what was missing and what the new source supplies.
brief.register: Common spatial metaphor using fill in. Here the gaps are missing information, not printed blanks in an exercise.
brief.boundaryZh: 補資料不等於所有問題已解、首份敘述全錯或可用猜測補成事實；需有來源及範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: 新資料可能只補部分，仍應標記未知或有分歧之處。
brief.outcomeZh: 能具體指出新資料補哪個缺口，保留已知與未知。

listening.en: The short report named the volunteers but did not explain their roles; the follow-up interview filled in the gaps by describing who organised the visits and who prepared the materials.
listening.zh: 短報告列義工姓名，卻未解釋角色；後訪描述誰安排探訪、誰備材料，補上缺資料。
listening.promptZh: 後訪補上哪方面資料？

options.en: The volunteers’ responsibilities, which the short report had not explained.
options.zh: 短報告未解釋的義工責任。

options.en: New names to replace everyone listed in the first report.
options.zh: 取代首報全部名單的新姓名。

options.en: The roles had already been described in the short report and were simply repeated later.
options.zh: 角色早在短報告交代，後來只是重述。

options.en: The exact future dates of every visit, according to the account.
options.zh: 按敘述，每次探訪的精確未來日期。

listening.explanationZh: 首報只有姓名，後訪才補誰安排、誰備料；不是重述已知角色，也未給新名單或所有日期。

reply.promptZh: 後續訪問補充了甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What did the follow-up interview add?

options.en: It explained what each named volunteer had done.
options.zh: 它解釋已列名義工各做甚麼。

options.en: It filled in the gaps about the volunteers’ roles.
options.zh: 它補上義工角色的缺資料。

options.en: We learned who arranged visits and who prepared materials.
options.zh: 我們知誰安排探訪、誰備材料。

options.en: It added the responsibilities missing from the short report.
options.zh: 它加上短報告缺少的責任資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句說補角色，不擴成全部真相已定。

scene.promptZh: 舊相片註明日期及人物，卻沒說拍攝場合；一位在場者說那是社區開幕聚會，但不記得主持姓名。哪句準確？

options.en: Her account fills in the gaps about the occasion, while the host’s name remains unknown.
options.zh: 她的敘述補場合資料，主持姓名仍未知。

options.en: The account confirms every missing detail, including the host’s name.
options.zh: 敘述確認每項缺細節，包括主持姓名。

options.en: One of the named people must have hosted the event because that person appears in the photograph.
options.zh: 其中一位具名人物必定是主持，因為相片拍到那人。

scene.explanationZh: 在場者補上場合，仍不記主持姓名；不能把部分補充當全部確認，也不能從入鏡便判定主持。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 filled in the gaps 得出？

options.en: Some missing information was supplied in context.
options.zh: 情境中有缺資料獲補充。

options.en: Every remaining uncertainty has necessarily been resolved.
options.zh: 每項剩餘不確定必定已解。

options.en: We still need to know which gaps the new material addresses.
options.zh: 仍需知新材料補哪些缺口。

contrast.explanationZh: 補資料未必補全部問題。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因訪問解釋了義工角色，就把所有探訪日期也記作確認，但訪問沒提日期。哪句較準確？

options.en: Keep the role information and mark the dates as still needing evidence.
options.zh: 保留角色資料，把日期標成仍需證據。

options.en: Transfer the confidence about roles to the dates without another source.
options.zh: 不用另一來源，就把角色的確定轉到日期。

options.en: Could we wait to include the verified roles until we also have the visit dates?
options.zh: 可否等取得探訪日期後，才加入已核實的角色？

dialogue.explanationZh: 角色已有資料可用，日期另需核對；既不把兩者確定程度混用，也不需因日期未明而省去已知角色。

speaking.en: The new account fills in the gaps about the roles, but some dates still need checking.
speaking.zh: 新敘述補上角色資料，但有些日期仍需核對。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說清補哪部分及尚缺甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要接手朋友寫到一半的遊戲說明，已有勝負條件，卻漏每人開始拿幾張牌；朋友回覆每人四張，但暫不記得加牌規則。你想更新說明並把仍待確認部分標記。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 補上已確認四張起手牌，保留加牌規則待查及原有勝負條件，不把猜測補成事實。

examples.en: Her reply fills in the gaps about the starting hand: each player gets four cards. I will add that detail and leave the extra-card rule marked for checking.
examples.zh: 她的回覆補上起手牌資料：每人四張。我會加這細節，把加牌規則留作待確認。

examples.en: We can fill in the gaps in the opening instructions without guessing the rule she cannot recall. The winning condition is already clear.
examples.zh: 我們可補起步指引缺資料，不猜她記不起的規則。勝負條件已清楚。

takeaways.en: The diary filled in the gaps in our account of how the group first met.
takeaways.zh: 日記補上小組怎樣首次見面的缺資料。

takeaways.en: We used the interview to fill in the gaps, while keeping the unresolved questions visible.
takeaways.zh: 我們用訪問補缺資料，同時仍標示未解問題。

brief.meaningEn: Extend across gender categories rather than being limited to just one.
brief.meaningZh: 延伸至不同性別群體，而非只限於其中一種。
brief.grammar: an interest/appeal cuts across gender; cut in past has the same spelling; cutting doubles t. Often specify the observed setting.
brief.register: Established cut-across boundary pattern applied to a social category. The phrase does not imply all people in a category have the same preferences.
brief.boundaryZh: 跨性別群體不表示每人同樣喜歡，也不證明其他差異已消失；需具體不同群體參與依據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要以性別替個人預定喜好，亦不把一次小組結果當所有人的定律。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述有根據的跨群體吸引，保留個別及觀察範圍。

sources.sentence: The appeal of a good story can cut across gender.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 19, table 2, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: In our reading group, interest in the mystery cut across gender: members of different genders brought questions about the ending, although their favourite characters varied.
listening.zh: 在讀書小組，謎案興趣跨越性別：不同性別成員都問結局，儘管喜歡角色各有不同。
listening.promptZh: 說話者觀察到甚麼，沒有觀察到甚麼？

options.en: Interest appeared among different genders, without identical individual preferences.
options.zh: 不同性別都有興趣，但個人偏好不相同。

options.en: Members shared an interest in the ending and also chose the same favourite character.
options.zh: 成員同樣對結局有興趣，也選了同一最愛角色。

options.en: Only one gender was allowed to bring questions.
options.zh: 只有一種性別獲准提問題。

options.en: The group’s questions establish the same pattern of interest among readers outside the group.
options.zh: 小組問題確立了組外讀者也有同樣興趣模式。

listening.explanationZh: 觀察限於這小組不同性別的共同興趣，且最愛角色不同；不能擴成組外讀者已確認的模式。

reply.promptZh: 讀書小組對謎案的興趣有甚麼特點？
reply.promptEn: What was distinctive about interest in the mystery within your group?

options.en: Members of different genders were interested in the ending.
options.zh: 不同性別成員都對結局有興趣。

options.en: The appeal cut across gender, even though favourite characters differed.
options.zh: 吸引力跨越性別，儘管喜歡角色不同。

options.en: The questions came from people of different genders rather than one group alone.
options.zh: 問題來自不同性別的人，不只一群。

options.en: We saw shared curiosity alongside different personal preferences.
options.zh: 我們看見共同好奇，同時有不同個人偏好。

reply.explanationZh: 四句描述已觀察跨群體興趣，不把偏好全同化。

scene.promptZh: 課後手作活動有不同性別同學持續參與，各自挑不同作品；你只想描述這次活動的跨群體吸引。哪句準確？

options.en: Its appeal cuts across gender in this group, while individual project choices differ.
options.zh: 在這小組，吸引力跨越性別，而個人作品選擇不同。

options.en: The students’ continued attendance shows they prefer similar kinds of projects.
options.zh: 同學持續出席，顯示他們偏好相近類型的作品。

options.en: This group’s attendance is enough to predict which project a new student will prefer from their gender.
options.zh: 這小組的出席情況，足以按新同學的性別預測其作品偏好。

scene.explanationZh: 不同性別都參與支持跨群體吸引，不代表作品偏好相同，也不足以按性別預測新同學選擇。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 cuts across gender 得出？

options.en: The appeal is not confined to a single gender in the stated context.
options.zh: 在所述情境，吸引力不限單一性別。

options.en: A shared interest establishes a shared favourite character among the participants.
options.zh: 共同興趣確立了參加者有共同最愛角色。

options.en: The actual participants and their choices still need to be described.
options.zh: 仍需描述實際參加者及其選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 共同的活動或故事興趣不等於相同角色偏好，個人選擇仍需了解。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想按性別預設誰會喜歡哪個角色，但小組成員選擇各不相同。哪句較準確？

options.en: Ask members about their choices rather than assigning tastes from gender.
options.zh: 問成員各自選擇，不按性別派喜好。

options.en: Could we use the most popular character overall as our prediction for each gender?
options.zh: 可否把整體最受歡迎角色，當作每種性別的預測？

options.en: The pattern in this small group is enough to predict choices in the next reading group.
options.zh: 這小組的模式，足以預測下一個讀書小組的選擇。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先問個人選擇，不能用整體最受歡迎角色推各性別偏好，也不能未核對就把小組模式套到下一組。

speaking.en: The story’s appeal cuts across gender in our group, but people still respond in different ways.
speaking.zh: 故事在我們小組的吸引力跨越性別，但大家反應仍有不同。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留跨群體與個別差異。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替合作解謎活動做小型試玩報告，不同性別參加者都有興趣，但樣本少。你想寫這次觀察，並提議下次問更多參加者哪些部分有吸引力，先不按性別替所有人預定喜好。用一至兩句英文寫報告建議。
writing.selfCheckZh: 有保留描述小樣本跨性別群體興趣，提出問更多人及具體特點，不由類別代個人回答或推成全體定律。

examples.en: The puzzle’s appeal seemed to cut across gender in our small trial. We should ask a wider group which parts interested them before making a broader claim.
examples.zh: 在小型試玩，解謎吸引力似乎跨越性別。作更廣說法前，我們應問更廣群體哪些部分吸引他們。

examples.en: We observed interest that cut across gender, but the sample was small. The next questionnaire should ask about the appealing features rather than assume everyone liked the same thing.
examples.zh: 我們觀察到跨性別群體興趣，但樣本小。下份問卷應問吸引之處，不假定人人喜歡同一事。

takeaways.en: Interest in the local history project cut across gender, while the questions people asked remained varied.
takeaways.zh: 地方史項目的興趣跨越性別，而大家問的問題仍多樣。

takeaways.en: The story can cut across gender without giving every reader the same response.
takeaways.zh: 故事可跨越性別吸引讀者，而不讓每位反應相同。
